  }\n            return Value.ofString(s);\n        }\n        throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                \"第 \" + rowIdx + \" 行列 \" + colName\n                        + \" 的值类型不支持（仅支持整数、字符串、null）\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 计划 ----------\n\n    private QueryPlan parsePlan(Map<String, Object> planObj) {\n        WindowSpec window = parseWindow(planObj.get(\"window\"));\n\n        Object fnsNode = planObj.get(\"functions\");\n        if (fnsNode == null) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST, \"plan 缺少 'functions'\");\n        }\n        List<Object> fnNodes = Json.asArray(fnsNode, \"plan.functions\");\n        if (fnNodes.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                    \"plan.functions 至少要请求一个窗口函数\");\n        }\n\n        List<FunctionCall> functions = new ArrayList<>();\n        LinkedHashSet<String> aliases = new LinkedHashSet<>();\n        for (Object fnNode : fnNodes) {\n            Map<String, Object> fn = Json.asObject(fnNode, \"functions 元素\");\n            String fnRaw = Json.requireString(fn, \"function\");\n            WindowFunction wf = WindowFunction.parse(fnRaw);\n\n            String alias = Json.optionalString(fn, \"alias\");\n            if (alias == null || alias.isBlank()) {\n                alias = defaultAlias(wf, fn.get(\"column\"), functions.size());\n            }\n            if (schema.contains(alias)) {\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.DUPLICATE_COLUMN,\n                        \"窗口输出列与输入列重名: \" + alias);\n            }\n            if (!aliases.add(alias.toLowerCase())) {\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.DUPLICATE_COLUMN,\n                        \"窗口输出列别名重复: \" + alias);\n            }\n\n            String argument = null;\n            if (wf == WindowFunction.SUM) {\n                argument = Json.requireString(fn, \"column\");\n                int argIdx = schema.requireIndex(argument);\n                if (schema.type(argIdx) != Value.Type.LONG) {\n                    throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.TYPE_MISMATCH,\n                            \"SUM 的参数列 \" + argument + \" 必须是 LONG 类型\");\n                }\n            } else if (fn.containsKey(\"column\")) {\n                // ROW_NUMBER / RANK 不接受参数，提前给出明确错误而不是静默忽略\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                        wf + \" 不接受 column 参数（它是排名函数）\");\n            }\n            functions.add(new FunctionCall(wf, alias, argument));\n        }\n\n        // 解析所有列引用，确保它们存在\n        for (String p : window.partitionBy()) {\n            schema.requireIndex(p);\n        }\n        for (OrderKey ok : window.orderBy()) {\n            schema.requireIndex(ok.column());\n        }\n\n        return new QueryPlan(\"inline\", window, functions);\n    }\n\n    private String defaultAlias(WindowFunction wf, Object columnNode, int index) {\n        if (wf == WindowFunction.SUM && columnNode instanceof String s) {\n            return \"sum_\" + s;\n        }\n        return wf.name().toLowerCase() + (index + 1);\n    }\n\n    private WindowSpec parseWindow(Object windowNode) {\n        List<String> partitionBy = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<OrderKey> orderBy = new ArrayList<>();\n        Frame frame = null;\n\n        if (windowNode != null) {\n            Map<String, Object> win = Json.asObject(windowNode, \"'window'\");\n\n            Object pb = win.get(\"partitionBy\");\n            if (pb != null) {\n                for (Object p : Json.asArray(pb, \"window.partitionBy\")) {\n                    if (!(p instanceof String s) || s.isBlank()) {\n                        throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                                \"partitionBy 元素必须是非空列名字符串\");\n                    }\n                    partitionBy.add(s);\n                }\n            }\n\n            Object ob = win.get(\"orderBy\");\n            if (ob != null) {\n                for (Object o : Json.asArray(ob, \"window.orderBy\")) {\n                    orderBy.add(parseOrderKey(o));\n                }\n            }\n\n            frame = parseFrame(win.get(\"frame\"));\n        }\n\n        if (frame == null) {\n            // SQL 默认帧：有 ORDER BY 时累计到当前行；无 ORDER BY 时整个分区\n            frame = orderBy.isEmpty() ? Frame.wholePartition() : Frame.cumulativeDefault();\n        }\n        return new WindowSpec(List.copyOf(partitionBy), List.copyOf(orderBy), frame);\n    }\n\n    private OrderKey parseOrderKey(Object node) {\n        if (node instanceof String s) {\n            return new OrderKey(s, Direction.ASC, NullOrder.defaultValue(Direction.ASC));\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> obj = Json.asObject(node, \"orderBy 元素\");\n        String column = Json.requireString(obj, \"column\");\n        Direction dir = Direction.ASC;\n        NullOrder no = null;\n        Object d = obj.get(\"direction\");\n        if (d instanceof String ds && !ds.isBlank()) {\n            dir = Direction.parse(ds);\n        }\n        Object n = obj.get(\"nullOrder\");\n        if (n instanceof String ns && !ns.isBlank()) {\n            no = NullOrder.parse(ns);\n        }\n        return new OrderKey(column, dir, no == null ? NullOrder.defaultValue(dir) : no);\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 帧 ----------\n\n    private Frame parseFrame(Object node) {\n        if (node == null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        if (node instanceof String s) {\n            return parseFrameText(s);\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> obj = Json.asObject(node, \"window.frame\");\n        FrameMode mode = FrameMode.ROWS;\n        Object m = obj.get(\"mode\");\n        if (m instanceof String ms && !ms.isBlank()) {\n            mode = FrameMode.parse(ms);\n        }\n        Object sNode = obj.get(\"start\");\n        Object eNode = obj.get(\"end\");\n        if (sNode == null || eNode == null) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                    \"frame 对象必须同时提供 start 和 end\");\n        }\n        return new Frame(mode, parseBound(sNode, \"start\"), parseBound(eNode, \"end\"));\n    }\n\n    private FrameBound parseBound(Object node, String which) {\n        if (node instanceof String s) {\n            return parseBoundText(s, which);\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> obj = Json.asObject(node, \"frame.\" + which);\n        String typeRaw = Json.requireString(obj, \"type\");\n        FrameBoundType type;\n        try {\n            type = FrameBoundType.valueOf(typeRaw.toUpperCase().replace(' ', '_'));\n        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                    \"非法帧边界类型: \" + typeRaw);\n        }\n        long offset = 0;\n        if (obj.containsKey(\"offset\")) {\n            offset = Json.requireLong(obj, \"offset\");\n        }\n        if ((type == FrameBoundType.PRECEDING || type == FrameBoundType.FOLLOWING)\n                && !obj.containsKey(\"offset\")) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                    \"帧边界 \" + type + \" 必须提供非负整数 offset\");\n        }\n        return new FrameBound(type, offset);\n    }\n\n    /** 解析 SQL 风格帧文本，如 \"ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING\"。 */\n    Frame parseFrameText(String text) {\n        String t = text.trim().toUpperCase();\n        if (!t.startsWith(\"ROWS\")) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                    \"帧文本必须以 ROWS 开头: \" + text);\n        }\n        String rest = t.substring(4).trim();\n        if (rest.startsWith(\"BETWEEN\")) {\n            String body = rest.substring(7).trim();\n            int and = body.indexOf(\" AND \");\n            if (and < 0) {\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                        \"BETWEEN 帧缺少 AND: \" + text);\n            }\n            FrameBound start = parseBoundText(body.substring(0, and).trim(), \"start\");\n            FrameBound end = parseBoundText(body.substring(and + 5).trim(), \"end\");\n            return new Frame(FrameMode.ROWS, start, end);\n        }\n        // 单边界简写：ROWS <bound> 等价 BETWEEN <bound> AND CURRENT ROW\n        if (rest.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME, \"帧文本不完整: \" + text);\n        }\n        return new Frame(FrameMode.ROWS,\n                parseBoundText(rest, \"start\"),\n                new FrameBound(FrameBoundType.CURRENT_ROW, 0));\n    }\n\n    private FrameBound parseBoundText(String text, String which) {\n        String t = text.trim().toUpperCase();\n        return switch (t) {\n            case \"UNBOUNDED PRECEDING\" ->\n                    new FrameBound(FrameBoundType.UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING, 0);\n            case \"UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING\" ->\n                    new FrameBound(FrameBoundType.UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING, 0);\n            case \"CURRENT ROW\" ->\n                    new FrameBound(FrameBoundType.CURRENT_ROW, 0);\n            default -> {\n                String[] parts = t.split(\"\\\\s+\");\n                if (parts.length != 2) {\n                    throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                            \"无法解析帧\" + which + \"边界: \" + text);\n                }\n                long off;\n                try {\n                    off = Long.parseLong(parts[0]);\n                } catch (NumberFormatException e) {\n                    throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                            \"帧位移必须是整数: \" + parts[0]);\n                }\n                yield switch (parts[1]) {\n                    case \"PRECEDING\" -> new FrameBound(FrameBoundType.PRECEDING, off);\n AND ...\" | {mode,start,end} },\n *     \"functions\": [ {\"function\":\"ROW_NUMBER|RANK|SUM\",\"alias\":\"...\",\"column\":\"...(SUM)\"} ]\n *   },\n *   \"export\": \"目录路径\"  或  {\"dir\":\"目录路径\"}\n * }\n */\npublic final class RequestParser {\n\n    private Schema schema;\n\n    public QueryRequest parse(Object rootNode) {\n        Map<String, Object> root = Json.asObject(rootNode, \"请求根节点\");\n\n        Relation data = parseData(root.get(\"data\"));\n        this.schema = data.schema();\n\n        Object planNode = root.get(\"plan\");\n        if (planNode == null) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST, \"缺少 'plan' 字段\");\n        }\n        QueryPlan plan = parsePlan(Json.asObject(planNode, \"'plan'\"));\n\n        String exportDir = parseExport(root.get(\"export\"));\n        return new QueryRequest(data, plan, exportDir);\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 数据 ----------\n\n    private Relation parseData(Object dataNode) {\n        if (dataNode == null) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST, \"缺少 'data' 字段\");\n        }\n        if (dataNode instanceof Map<?, ?> dm && dm.containsKey(\"file\")) {\n            Object f = dm.get(\"file\");\n            if (!(f instanceof String filePath) || filePath.isBlank()) {\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                        \"data.file 必须是非空字符串路径\");\n            }\n            Object loaded = Json.parseFile(Path.of(filePath));\n            return buildRelation(Json.asObject(loaded, \"数据文件根节点\"));\n        }\n        return buildRelation(Json.asObject(dataNode, \"'data'\"));\n    }\n\n    private Relation buildRelation(Map<String, Object> dataObj) {\n        Object colsNode = dataObj.get(\"columns\");\n        if (colsNode == null) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST, \"data 缺少 'columns'\");\n        }\n        List<Object> colNodes = Json.asArray(colsNode, \"data.columns\");\n        if (colNodes.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST, \"data.columns 至少要有一列\");\n        }\n\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Value.Type> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        LinkedHashSet<String> seen = new LinkedHashSet<>();\n        for (Object colNode : colNodes) {\n            String name;\n            Value.Type type = Value.Type.LONG;\n            if (colNode instanceof String s) {\n                name = s; // 简写：裸列名默认 LONG\n            } else if (colNode instanceof Map<?, ?> cm) {\n                Object nm = cm.get(\"name\");\n                if (!(nm instanceof String ns) || ns.isBlank()) {\n                    throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                            \"列定义的 name 必须是非空字符串\");\n                }\n                name = ns;\n                Object tp = cm.get(\"type\");\n                if (tp != null) {\n                    if (!(tp instanceof String ts)) {\n                        throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                                \"列 \" + name + \" 的 type 必须是字符串\");\n                    }\n                    type = switch (ts.toUpperCase()) {\n                        case \"LONG\", \"INT\", \"INTEGER\", \"BIGINT\" -> Value.Type.LONG;\n                        case \"STRING\", \"TEXT\", \"VARCHAR\" -> Value.Type.STRING;\n                        default -> throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.UNSUPPORTED,\n                                \"列 \" + name + \" 使用了不支持的类型: \" + ts\n                                        + \"（仅支持 LONG / STRING）\");\n                    };\n                }\n            } else {\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                        \"列定义必须是字符串或 {name,type} 对象\");\n            }\n            if (!seen.add(name.toLowerCase())) {\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.DUPLICATE_COLUMN,\n                        \"输入列重名（大小写不敏感）: \" + name);\n            }\n            names.add(name);\n            types.add(type);\n        }\n        Schema sch = new Schema(names, types);\n\n        Object rowsNode = dataObj.get(\"rows\");\n        if (rowsNode == null) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST, \"data 缺少 'rows'\");\n        }\n        List<Object> rowNodes = Json.asArray(rowsNode, \"data.rows\");\n        List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>(rowNodes.size());\n        for (int r = 0; r < rowNodes.size(); r++) {\n            List<Object> cells = Json.asArray(rowNodes.get(r), \"第 \" + r + \" 行\");\n            if (cells.size() != sch.size()) {\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                        \"第 \" + r + \" 行列数为 \" + cells.size()\n                                + \"，与 schema 的 \" + sch.size() + \" 列不符\");\n            }\n            Value[] values = new Value[sch.size()];\n            for (int c = 0; c < cells.size(); c++) {\n                values[c] = convertCell(cells.get(c), sch.type(c), sch.name(c), r);\n            }\n            rows.add(new Row(values, r));\n        }\n        return new Relation(sch, rows);\n    }\n\n    private Value convertCell(Object raw, Value.Type declaredType, String colName, int rowIdx) {\n        if (raw == null) {\n            return Value.NULL;\n        }\n        if (raw instanceof Long l) {\n            if (declaredType != Value.Type.LONG) {\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.TYPE_MISMATCH,\n                        \"第 \" + rowIdx + \" 行列 \" + colName + \" 声明为 STRING，却收到整数 \" + l);\n            }\n            return Value.ofLong(l);\n        }\n        if (raw instanceof String s) {\n            if (declaredType != Value.Type.STRING) {\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.TYPE_MISMATCH,\n                        \"第 \" + rowIdx + \" 行列 \" + colName + \" 声明为 LONG，却收到字符串 '\" + s + \"'\");\n            }\n            return Value.ofString(s);\n        }\n        throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                \"第 \" + rowIdx + \" 行列 \" + colName\n                        + \" 的值类型不支持（仅支持整数、字符串、null）\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 计划 ----------\n\n    private QueryPlan parsePlan(Map<String, Object> planObj) {\n        WindowSpec window = parseWindow(planObj.get(\"window\"));\n\n        Object fnsNode = planObj.get(\"functions\");\n        if (fnsNode == null) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST, \"plan 缺少 'functions'\");\n        }\n        List<Object> fnNodes = Json.asArray(fnsNode, \"plan.functions\");\n        if (fnNodes.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                    \"plan.functions 至少要请求一个窗口函数\");\n        }\n\n        List<FunctionCall> functions = new ArrayList<>();\n        LinkedHashSet<String> aliases = new LinkedHashSet<>();\n        for (Object fnNode : fnNodes) {\n            Map<String, Object> fn = Json.asObject(fnNode, \"functions 元素\");\n            String fnRaw = Json.requireString(fn, \"function\");\n            WindowFunction wf = WindowFunction.parse(fnRaw);\n\n            String alias = Json.optionalString(fn, \"alias\");\n            if (alias == null || alias.isBlank()) {\n                alias = defaultAlias(wf, fn.get(\"column\"), functions.size());\n            }\n            if (schema.contains(alias)) {\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.DUPLICATE_COLUMN,\n                        \"窗口输出列与输入列重名: \" + alias);\n            }\n            if (!aliases.add(alias.toLowerCase())) {\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.DUPLICATE_COLUMN,\n                        \"窗口输出列别名重复: \" + alias);\n            }\n\n            String argument = null;\n            if (wf == WindowFunction.SUM) {\n                argument = Json.requireString(fn, \"column\");\n                int argIdx = schema.requireIndex(argument);\n                if (schema.type(argIdx) != Value.Type.LONG) {\n                    throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.TYPE_MISMATCH,\n                            \"SUM 的参数列 \" + argument + \" 必须是 LONG 类型\");\n                }\n            } else if (fn.containsKey(\"column\")) {\n                // ROW_NUMBER / RANK 不接受参数，提前给出明确错误而不是静默忽略\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                        wf + \" 不接受 column 参数（它是排名函数）\");\n            }\n            functions.add(new FunctionCall(wf, alias, argument));\n        }\n\n        // 解析所有列引用，确保它们存在\n        for (String p : window.partitionBy()) {\n            schema.requireIndex(p);\n        }\n        for (OrderKey ok : window.orderBy()) {\n            schema.requireIndex(ok.column());\n        }\n\n        return new QueryPlan(\"inline\", window, functions);\n    }\n\n    private String defaultAlias(WindowFunction wf, Object columnNode, int index) {\n        if (wf == WindowFunction.SUM && columnNode instanceof String s) {\n            return \"sum_\" + s;\n        }\n        return wf.name().toLowerCase() + (index + 1);\n    }\n\n    private WindowSpec parseWindow(Object windowNode) {\n        List<String> partitionBy = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<OrderKey> orderBy = new ArrayList<>();\n        Frame frame = null;\n\n        if (windowNode != null) {\n            Map<String, Object> win = Json.asObject(windowNode, \"'window'\");\n\n            Object pb = win.get(\"partitionBy\");\n            if (pb != null) {\n                for (Object p : Json.asArray(pb, \"window.partitionBy\")) {\n                    if (!(p instanceof String s) || s.isBlank()) {\n                        throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                                \"partitionBy 元素必须是非空列名字符串\");\n                    }\n                    partitionBy.add(s);\n                }\n            }\n\n            Object ob = win.get(\"orderBy\");\n            if (ob != null) {\n                for (Object o : Json.asArray(ob, \"window.orderBy\")) {\n                    orderBy.add(parseOrderKey(o));\n                }\n            }\n\n            frame = parseFrame(win.get(\"frame\"));\n        }\n\n        if (frame == null) {\n            // SQL 默认帧：有 ORDER BY 时累计到当前行；无 ORDER BY 时整个分区\n            frame = orderBy.isEmpty() ? Frame.wholePartition() : Frame.cumulativeDefault();\n        }\n        return new WindowSpec(List.copyOf(partitionBy), List.copyOf(orderBy), frame);\n    }\n\n    private OrderKey parseOrderKey(Object node) {\n        if (node instanceof String s) {\n            return new OrderKey(s, Direction.ASC, NullOrder.defaultValue(Direction.ASC));\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> obj = Json.asObject(node, \"orderBy 元素\");\n        String column = Json.requireString(obj, \"column\");\n        Direction dir = Direction.ASC;\n        NullOrder no = null;\n        Object d = obj.get(\"direction\");\n        if (d instanceof String ds && !ds.isBlank()) {\n            dir = Direction.parse(ds);\n        }\n        Object n = obj.get(\"nullOrder\");\n        if (n instanceof String ns && !ns.isBlank()) {\n            no = NullOrder.parse(ns);\n        }\n        return new OrderKey(column, dir, no == null ? NullOrder.defaultValue(dir) : no);\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 帧 ----------\n\n    private Frame parseFrame(Object node) {\n        if (node == null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        if (node instanceof String s) {\n            return parseFrameText(s);\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> obj = Json.asObject(node, \"window.frame\");\n        FrameMode mode = FrameMode.ROWS;\n        Object m = obj.get(\"mode\");\n        if (m instanceof String ms && !ms.isBlank()) {\n            mode = FrameMode.parse(ms);\n        }\n        Object sNode = obj.get(\"start\");\n        Object eNode = obj.get(\"end\");\n        if (sNode == null || eNode == null) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                    \"frame 对象必须同时提供 start 和 end\");\n        }\n        return new Frame(mode, parseBound(sNode, \"start\"), parseBound(eNode, \"end\"));\n    }\n\n    private FrameBound parseBound(Object node, String which) {\n        if (node instanceof String s) {\n            return parseBoundText(s, which);\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> obj = Json.asObject(node, \"frame.\" + which);\n        String typeRaw = Json.requireString(obj, \"type\");\n        FrameBoundType type;\n        try {\n            type = FrameBoundType.valueOf(typeRaw.toUpperCase().replace(' ', '_'));\n        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                    \"非法帧边界类型: \" + typeRaw);\n        }\n        long offset = 0;\n        if (obj.containsKey(\"offset\")) {\n            offset = Json.requireLong(obj, \"offset\");\n        }\n        if ((type == FrameBoundType.PRECEDING || type == FrameBoundType.FOLLOWING)\n                && !obj.containsKey(\"offset\")) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                    \"帧边界 \" + type + \" 必须提供非负整数 offset\");\n        }\n        return new FrameBound(type, offset);\n    }\n\n    /** 解析 SQL 风格帧文本，如 \"ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING\"。 */\n    Frame parseFrameText(String text) {\n        String t = text.trim().toUpperCase();\n        if (!t.startsWith(\"ROWS\")) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                    \"帧文本必须以 ROWS 开头: \" + text);\n        }\n        String rest = t.substring(4).trim();\n        if (rest.startsWith(\"BETWEEN\")) {\n            String body = rest.substring(7).trim();\n            int and = body.indexOf(\" AND \");\n            if (and < 0) {\n                throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                        \"BETWEEN 帧缺少 AND: \" + text);\n            }\n            FrameBound start = parseBoundText(body.substring(0, and).trim(), \"start\");\n            FrameBound end = parseBoundText(body.substring(and + 5).trim(), \"end\");\n            return new Frame(FrameMode.ROWS, start, end);\n        }\n        // 单边界简写：ROWS <bound> 等价 BETWEEN <bound> AND CURRENT ROW\n        if (rest.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME, \"帧文本不完整: \" + text);\n        }\n        return new Frame(FrameMode.ROWS,\n                parseBoundText(rest, \"start\"),\n                new FrameBound(FrameBoundType.CURRENT_ROW, 0));\n    }\n\n    private FrameBound parseBoundText(String text, String which) {\n        String t = text.trim().toUpperCase();\n        return switch (t) {\n            case \"UNBOUNDED PRECEDING\" ->\n                    new FrameBound(FrameBoundType.UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING, 0);\n            case \"UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING\" ->\n                    new FrameBound(FrameBoundType.UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING, 0);\n            case \"CURRENT ROW\" ->\n                    new FrameBound(FrameBoundType.CURRENT_ROW, 0);\n            default -> {\n                String[] parts = t.split(\"\\\\s+\");\n                if (parts.length != 2) {\n                    throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                            \"无法解析帧\" + which + \"边界: \" + text);\n                }\n                long off;\n                try {\n                    off = Long.parseLong(parts[0]);\n                } catch (NumberFormatException e) {\n                    throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                            \"帧位移必须是整数: \" + parts[0]);\n                }\n                yield switch (parts[1]) {\n                    case \"PRECEDING\" -> new FrameBound(FrameBoundType.PRECEDING, off);\n                    case \"FOLLOWING\" -> new FrameBound(FrameBoundType.FOLLOWING, off);\n                    default -> throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME,\n                            \"无法解析帧\" + which + \"边界: \" + text);\n                };\n            }\n        };\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 导出 ----------\n\n    private String parseExport(Object node) {\n        if (node == null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        if (node instanceof String s) {\n            return s;\n        }\n        if (node instanceof Map<?, ?> m) {\n            Object dir =        \"export 对象必须包含非空字符串字段 dir\");\n        }\n        throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                \"export 必须是目录字符串或 {\\\"dir\\\": ...} 对象\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c64ea33c-ed66-4335-930b-12f3f3d7b0d0","session_id":"d67f3da5-4ea2-42a4-af1b-36f0c143d1cb","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/b","sessionId":"d67f3da5-4ea2-42a4-af1b-36f0c143d1cb","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp13-b","slug":"wiggly-stirring-candy"}

{"parentUuid":"df80e53b-0480-4660-b89f-ff9d00479778","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_uwd4l6tnmw3c1dbu287t70bq","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/b/src/windowengine/engine/WindowOperator.java","content":"package windowengine.engine;\n\nimport windowengine.EngineException;\nimport windowengine.ErrorCode;\nimport windowengine.Row;\nimport windowengine.Value;\nimport windowengine.plan.FrameBound;\nimport windowengine.plan.FrameBoundType;\nimport windowengine.plan.FunctionCall;\nimport windowengine.plan.OrderKey;\nimport windowengine.plan.WindowFunction;\nimport windowengine.plan.WindowSpec;\n\nimport java.math.BigInteger;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 窗口算子：对一个已按 ORDER BY 排好序的分区计算各窗口函数。\n *\n * 三种函数的语义（全部按 SQL 标准定义）：\n * - ROW_NUMBER：分区内行的物理序号（1 基）。并列键相等时也不并列，\n *   用原始输入行号稳定打破并列。\n * - RANK：排名（1 基）。并列键完全相等的行得到相同排名，之后的排名跳号\n *   （1,1,3）。无 ORDER BY 时整个分区互为并列，全得 1。\n * - SUM(x) over ROWS 帧：帧是 [start,end] 的物理行区间，帧按分区边界裁剪，\n *   不相交或起点超过终点时帧为空，空帧结果为 NULL；帧内 NULL 输入被忽略，\n *   全 NULL 的帧同样得到 NULL；求和用 BigInteger 前缀和计算，最终值必须落在\n *   long 范围内，否则抛 OVERFLOW。\n */\npublic final class WindowOperator {\n\n    private final WindowSpec spec;\n    private final int[] orderColumns;\n    private final int[] sumArgumentColumns;\n\n    public WindowOperator(WindowSpec spec, List<FunctionCall> functions) {\n        this.spec = spec;\n        this.orderColumns = spec.orderBy().stream()\n                .mapToInt(ok -> -1).toArray(); // 占位，列下标在 apply 前由 schema 解析\n        this.sumArgumentColumns = new int[functions.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < functions.size(); i++) {\n            this.sumArgumentColumns[i] = -1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 计算一个排序后分区。\n     *\n     * @param sorted           分区内行，已按 ORDER BY（含稳定兜底）排序\n     * @param resolvedOrderCols 排序键在 schema 中的列下标\n     * @param functions        函数调用\n     * @param argColumns       每个函数的入参列下标（SUM 为参数列，其余 -1）\n     * @return 每行一个 Value[]，顺序与 functions 对应，即结果列\n     */\n    public Value[][] apply(List<Row> sorted,\n                           int[] resolvedOrderCols,\n                           List<FunctionCall> functions,\n                           int[] argColumns) {\n        int n = sorted.size();\n        int fnCount = functions.size();\n        Value[][] out = new Value[n][fnCount];\n        this.orderColumnsLocal = resolvedOrderCols;\n\n        for (int f = 0; f < fnCount; f++) {\n            WindowFunction fn = functions.get(f).function();\n            switch (fn) {\n                case ROW_NUMBER -> evalRowNumber(sorted, out, f);\n                case RANK -> evalRank(sorted, out, f);\n                case SUM -> evalSum(sorted, out, f, argColumns[f], functions.get(f).alias());\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private int[] orderColumnsLocal;\n\n    // ---------- ROW_NUMBER ----------\n\n    private void evalRowNumber(List<Row> sorted, Value[][] out, int f) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < sorted.size(); i++) {\n            out[i][f] = Value.ofLong(i + 1L);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- RANK ----------\n\n    private void evalRank(List<Row> sorted, Value[][] out, int f) {\n        int n = sorted.size();\n        if (n == 0) {\n windowengine.plan.FunctionCall;\nimport windowengine.plan.WindowFunction;\nimport windowengine.plan.WindowSpec;\n\nimport java.math.BigInteger;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 窗口算子：对一个已按 ORDER BY 排好序的分区计算各窗口函数。\n *\n * 三种函数的语义（全部按 SQL 标准定义）：\n * - ROW_NUMBER：分区内行的物理序号（1 基）。并列键相等时也不并列，\n *   用原始输入行号稳定打破并列。\n * - RANK：排名（1 基）。并列键完全相等的行得到相同排名，之后的排名跳号\n *   （1,1,3）。无 ORDER BY 时整个分区互为并列，全得 1。\n * - SUM(x) over ROWS 帧：帧是 [start,end] 的物理行区间，帧按分区边界裁剪，\n *   不相交或起点超过终点时帧为空，空帧结果为 NULL；帧内 NULL 输入被忽略，\n *   全 NULL 的帧同样得到 NULL；求和用 BigInteger 前缀和计算，最终值必须落在\n *   long 范围内，否则抛 OVERFLOW。\n */\npublic final class WindowOperator {\n\n    private final WindowSpec spec;\n\n    public WindowOperator(WindowSpec spec) {\n        this.spec = spec;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 计算一个排序后分区。\n     *\n     * @param sorted         分区内行，已按 ORDER BY（含稳定兜底）排序\n     * @param orderColumns   排序键在 schema 中的列下标\n     * @param functions      函数调用\n     * @param argColumns     每个函数的入参列下标（SUM 为参数列，其余 -1）\n     * @return 每行一个 Value[]，顺序与 functions 对应，即结果列\n     */\n    public Value[][] apply(List<Row> sorted,\n                           int[] orderColumns,\n                           List<FunctionCall> functions,\n                           int[] argColumns) {\n        int n = sorted.size();\n        int fnCount = functions.size();\n        Value[][] out = new Value[n][fnCount];\n\n        for (int f = 0; f < fnCount; f++) {\n            WindowFunction fn = functions.get(f).function();\n            switch (fn) {\n                case ROW_NUMBER -> evalRowNumber(sorted, out, f);\n                case RANK -> evalRank(sorted, out, f, orderColumns);\n                case SUM -> evalSum(sorted, out, f, argColumns[f], functions.get(f).alias());\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    // ---------- ROW_NUMBER ----------\n\n    private void evalRowNumber(List<Row> sorted, Value[][] out, int f) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < sorted.size(); i++) {\n            out[i][f] = Value.ofLong(i + 1L);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- RANK ----------\n\n    private void evalRank(List<Row> sorted, Value[][] out, int f, int[] orderColumns) {\n        int n = sorted.size();\n        if (n == 0) {\n            return;\n        }\n        if (orderColumns.length == 0) {\n            // 无 ORDER BY：整个分区并列，排名全为 1（SQL 标准）\n            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                out[i][f] = Value.ofLong(1L);\n            }\n            return;\n        }\n        // 逐行扫描：与上一行互为并列则沿用排名，否则排名 = 物理位置 + 1（造成跳号）\n        out[0][f] = Value.ofLong(1L);\n        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {\n            if (isPeer(sorted.get(i - 1), sorted.get(i), orderColumns)) {\n                out[i][f] = out[i - 1][f];\n            } else {\n                out[i][f] = Value.ofLong(i + 1L);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 并列判定：所有 ORDER BY 列值等值（与 ASC/DESC、NULL 位置无关；NULL 互为并列）。 */\n    private boolean isPeer(Row a, Row b, int[] orderColumns) {\n        for (int col : orderColumns) {\n            if (!a.get(col).valueEquals(b.get(col))) {\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // ---------- SUM over ROWS ----------\n\n    private void evalSum(List<Row> sorted, Value[][] out, int f,\n                         int argColumn, String alias) {\n        int n = sorted.size();\n        if (n == 0) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // 前缀和：prefix[i+1] = 前 i 个非 NULL 值之和；nullCount[i+1] = 前 i 行中 NULL 数。\n        // 用 BigInteger 累积，数学结果超出 long 时在取值阶段抛 OVERFLOW。\n        BigInteger[] prefix = new BigInteger[n + 1];\n        int[] nullCount = new int[n + 1];\n        prefix[0] = BigInteger.ZERO;\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Value v = sorted.get(i).get(argColumn);\n            if (v.isNull()) {\n                prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i];\n                nullCount[i + 1] = nullCount[i] + 1;\n            } else {\n                long lv;\n                try {\n                    lv = v.asLong();\n                } catch (EngineException e) {\n                    throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.TYPE_MISMATCH,\n                            \"SUM(\" + alias + \") 帧内出现非 LONG 值（行 sourceIndex=\"\n                                    + sorted.get(i).sourceIndex() + \"）\", e);\n                }\n                prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i].add(BigInteger.valueOf(lv));\n                nullCount[i + 1] = nullCount[i];\n            }\n        }\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            int lo = frameIndex(i, spec.frame().start(), n);\n            int hi = frameIndex(i, spec.frame().end(), n);\n            // 与分区 [0,n-1] 求交；不相交 / start>end 即空帧\n            int clampedLo = Math.max(lo, 0);\n            int clampedHi = Math.min(hi, n - 1);\n            if (lo > hi || clampedLo > clampedHi) {\n                out[i][f] = Value.NULL;\n                continue;\n            }\n            int nonNulls = (clampedHi - clampedLo + 1)\n                    - (nullCount[clampedHi + 1] - nullCount[clampedLo]);\n            if (nonNulls == 0) {\n                out[i][f] = Value.NULL; // 帧内全是 NULL：忽略它们后无值可聚合\n                continue;\n            }\n            BigInteger sum = prefix[clampedHi + 1].subtract(prefix[clampedLo]);\n            out[i][f] = Value.ofLong(toLongExact(sum, alias, sorted.get(i)));\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 计算帧边界相对分区行 i 的下标（可能越界）。\n     * 位移使用 long 运算避免 offset 极大时 int 加法溢出；\n     * UNBOUNDED 直接钉在分区端点，越界值最后收缩到 int 极值，交由求交逻辑裁剪。\n     */\n    private static int frameIndex(int currentRow, FrameBound bound, int partitionSize) {\n        long idx = switch (bound.type()) {\n            case UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING -> 0L;\n            case UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING -> (long) partitionSize - 1;\n            case CURRENT_ROW -> currentRow;\n            case PRECEDING -> (long) currentRow - bound.offset();\n            case FOLLOWING -> (long) currentRow + bound.offset();\n        };\n        if (idx < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {\n            return Integer.MIN_VALUE;\n        }\n        if (idx > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {\n            return Integer.MAX_VALUE;\n        }\n        return (int) idx;\n    }\n\n    private static long toLongExact(BigInteger value, String alias, Row contextRow) {\n        try {\n            return value.longValueExact();\n        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {\n            throw new EngineException(ErrorCode.OVERFLOW,\n                    \"SUM(\" + alias + \") 窗口聚合结果 \" + value\n 分区内排序 -&gt; 窗口算子 -&gt; 按原始行序收集输出。\n *\n * 输出顺序约定：结果行严格按输入行顺序返回（不是分区/排序后的顺序），\n * 每行 = 原始列 + 追加的窗口输出列。这样调用方可以直接把结果与输入按行对齐。\n */\npublic final class WindowEngine {\n\n    public Relation execute(QueryRequest request) {\n        Relation input = request.data();\n        QueryPlan plan = request.plan();\n        WindowSpec spec = plan.window();\n        List<FunctionCall> functions = plan.functions();\n        Schema inSchema = input.schema();\n\n        // 输出 schema：原列 + 函数别名（SUM 的结果列可能出现 NULL，但逻辑类型仍是 LONG）\n        Schema outSchema = inSchema;\n        for (FunctionCall fn : functions) {\n            outSchema = outSchema.withColumn(fn.alias(), fn.function().resultType());\n        }\n\n        int[] orderColumns = spec.orderBy().stream()\n                .mapToInt(ok -> inSchema.requireIndex(ok.column()))\n                .toArray();\n        int[] argColumns = new int[functions.size()];\n        for (int f = 0; // List.sort 是稳定排序\n            Value[][] windowValues = operator.apply(sorted, orderColumns, functions, argColumns);\n            for (int i = 0; i < sorted.size(); i++) {\n                Row row = sorted.get(i);\n                Value[] full = new Value[totalColumns];\n                System.arraycopy(row.cells(), 0, full, 0, inSchema.size());\n                System.arraycopy(windowValues[i], 0, full, inSchema.size(), functions.size());\n                resultBySource[row.sourceIndex()] = full;\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<Row> outRows = new ArrayList<>(input.rowCount());\n        for (int i = 0; i < input.rowCount(); i++) {\n            outRows.add(new Row(resultBySource[i], i));\n        }\n        return new Relation(outSchema, outRows);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_38f665d853746063a36ea8d7","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2669,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":58168,"output_tokens":880,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_wqbk6nh3xv7s06l38vpr4u5p":{"content":"package windowengine.engine;\n\nimport windowengine.QueryRequest;\nimport windowengine.Relation;\nimport windowengine.Row;\nimport windowengine.Schema;\nimport windowengine.Value;\nimport windowengine.plan.FunctionCall;\nimport windowengine.plan.QueryPlan;\nimport windowengine.plan.WindowFunction;\nimport windowengine.plan.WindowSpec;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Collections;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 单机内存查询执行器：分区 -&gt; {"parentUuid":"7010e111-860a-434a-84e8-0915445d2022","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_0uo0dnbvnp164lq9qcdapr1a","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/b/src/windowengine/JsonCodec.java","content":"package windowengine;\n\nimport windowengine.plan.Direction;\nimport windowengine.plan.Frame;\nimport windowengine.plan.FrameBound;\nimport windowengine.plan.FunctionCall;\nimport windowengine.plan.OrderKey;\nimport windowengine.plan.QueryPlan;\nimport windowengine.plan.WindowFunction;\nimport windowengine.plan.WindowSpec;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 把内存对象序列化为可导出 / 可回读的 JSON 结构：\n * - 关系序列化为 {\"columns\":[{name,type}],\"rows\":[[...]]}，与请求中的 data 同构，\n *   因此导出的数据文件可以直接作为另一个请求的 data.file 回读；\n * - 执行计划导出为规范化 JSON（默认值被显式展开，帧同时给出文本与结构形式）。\n */\npublic final class JsonCodec {\n\n    private JsonCodec() {\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 关系 ----------\n\n    public static Map<String, Object> relationToJson(Relation relation) {\n        List<Object> columns = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < relation.schema().size(); i++) {\n            Map<String, Object> col = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            col.put(\"name\", relation.schema().name(i));\n            col.put(\"type\", relation.schema().type(i).name());\n            columns.add(col);\n        }\n\n        List<Object> rows = new ArrayList<>(relation.rowCount());\n        for (Row row : relation.rows()) {\n            List<Object> cells = new ArrayList<>(relation.schema().size());\n            for (int c = 0; c < relation.schema().size(); c++) {\n                cells.add(valueToJson(row.get(c)));\n            }\n            rows.add(cells);\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> root = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        root.put(\"columns\", columns);\n        root.put(\"rows\", rows);\n        return root;\n    }\n\n    private static Object valueToJson(Value v) {\n        return switch (v.type()) {\n            case NULL -> null;\n            case LONG -> v.asLong();\n            case STRING -> v.asString();\n        };\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 执行计划 ----------\n\n    public static Map<String, Object> planToJson(QueryPlan plan) {\n        Map<String, Object> window = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        window.put(\"partitionBy\", plan.window().partitionBy());\n\n        List<Object> order = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (OrderKey key : plan.window().orderBy()) {\n            Map<String, Object> k = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            k.put(\"column\", key.column());\n            k.put(\"direction\", key.direction().name());\n            k.put(\"nullOrder\", key.nullOrder().name());\n            k.put(\"nullOrderIsDefault\",\n                    key.nullOrder() == Direction.ASC == (key.direction() == Direction.ASC)\n                            ? key.nullOrder() == windowengine.plan.NullOrder.defaultValue(key.direction())\n                            : key.nullOrder() == windowengine.plan.NullOrder.defaultValue(key.direction()));\n            order.add(k);\n        }\n        window.put(\"orderBy\", order);\n        window.put(\"frame\", frameToJson(plan.window().frame()));\n\n        List<Object> functions = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (FunctionCall fn : plan.functions()) {\n            Map<String, Object> f = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            f.put(\"function\", fn.function().name());\n            f.put(\"alias\", fn.alias());\n            if (fn.function() == WindowFunction.SUM) {\n                f.put(\"column\", fn.argumentColumn());\n            }\n            functions.add(f);\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> root = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        root.put(\"input\", plan.input());\n        root.put(\"window\", window);\n        root.put(\"functions\", functions);\n        return root;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> frameToJson(Frame frame) {\n        Map<String, Object> f = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        f.put(\"mode\", frame.mode().name());\n        f.put(\"start\", boundToJson(frame.start()));\n        f.put(\"end\", boundToJson(frame.end()));\n        f.put(\"sqlText\", frame.describe());\n        return f;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> boundToJson(FrameBound bound) {\n        Map<String, Object> b = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        b.put(\"type\", bound.type().name());\n        if (bound.type() == windowengine.plan.FrameBoundType.PRECEDING\n                || bound.type() == windowengine.plan.FrameBoundType.FOLLOWING) {\n            b.put(\"offset\", bound.offset());\n        }\n        return b;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_86019c621b7ebaacea23f0a6","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1554,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":60216,"output_tokens":1211,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_0uo0dnbvnp164lq9qcdapr1a":{"content":"package 把内存对象序列化为可导出 / 可回读的 JSON 结构：\n * - 关系序列化为 {\"columns\":[{name,type}],\"rows\":[[...]]}，与请求中的 data 同构，\n *   因此导出的数据文件可以直接作为另一个请求的 data.file 回读；\n * - 执行计划导出为规范化 JSON（默认值被显式展开，帧同时给出文本与结构形式）。\n */\npublic final class JsonCodec {\n\n    private JsonCodec() {\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 关系 ----------\n\n    public static Map<String, Object> relationToJson(Relation relation) {\n        List<Object> columns = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < relation.schema().size(); i++) {\n            Map<String, Object> col = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            col.put(\"name\", relation.schema().name(i));\n            col.put(\"type\", relation.schema().type(i).name());\n            columns.add(col);\n        }\n\n        List<Object> rows = new relation.schema().size(); c++) {\n                cells.add(valueToJson(row.get(c)));\n            }\n            rows.add(cells);\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> root = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        root.put(\"columns\", columns);\n        root.put(\"rows\", rows);\n        return root;\n    }\n\n    private static Object valueToJson(Value v) {\n        return switch (v.type()) {\n            case NULL -> null;\n            case LONG -> v.asLong();\n            case STRING -> v.asString();\n        };\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 执行计划 ----------\n\n    public List<Object> order = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (OrderKey key : plan.window().orderBy()) {\n            Map<String, Object> k = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            k.put(\"column\", key.column());\n            k.put(\"direction\", key.direction().name());\n            k.put(\"nullOrder\", key.nullOrder().name());\n            k.put(\"nullOrderIsDefault\",\n                    key.nullOrder() == windowengine.plan.NullOrder.defaultValue(key.direction()));\n            order.add(k);\n        }\n        window.put(\"orderBy\", order);\n        window.put(\"frame\", frameToJson(plan.window().frame()));\n\n        List<Object> functions = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (FunctionCall fn : plan.functions()) {\n            Map<String, Object> f = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            f.put(\"function\", fn.function().name());\n            f.put(\"alias\", fn.alias());\n            if (fn.function() == WindowFunction.SUM) {\n                f.put(\"column\", fn.argumentColumn());\n            }\n            functions.add(f);\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> root = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        root.put(\"input\", plan.input());\n        root.put(\"window\", window);\n        root.put(\"functions\", functions);\n        return root;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> frameToJson(Frame frame) {\n        Map<String, Object> f = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        f.put(\"mode\", frame.mode().name());\n        f.put(\"start\", boundToJson(frame.start()));\n        f.put(\"end\", boundToJson(frame.end()));\n        f.put(\"sqlText\", frame.describe());\n        return f;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> boundToJson(FrameBound bound) {\n        Map<String, Object> b = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        b.put(\"type\", bound.type().name());\n        if (bound.type() == windowengine.plan.FrameBoundType.PRECEDING\n                || bound.type() == windowengine.plan.FrameBoundType.FOLLOWING) {\n            b.put(\"offset\", bound.offset());\n        }\n        return b;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":6,"newStart":1,"newLines":5,"lines":[" package windowengine;"," ","-import windowengine.plan.Direction;"," import windowengine.plan.Frame;"," import windowengine;\n\nimport windowengine.engine.WindowEngine;\n\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * JSON 请求入口（纯后端，无任何 HTTP / 前端依赖）。\n *\n * 用法：\n *   java windowengine.Main [请求文件.json ...]\n *\n * - 提供文件路径：依次执行每个请求文件（相对路径相对于进程工作目录解析）；\n * - 不提供参数：从标准输入读取一个 JSON 请求；\n * - 每个请求独立输出一行（多个文件时分隔输出），stdout 为结果 JSON，\n *   错误以 {\"ok\":false,\"error\":{...}} 输出并以非零码退出。\n *\n * 退出码：0 成功；2 请求/执行错误（错误码在 JSON 中）；1 用法/IO 级错误。\n */\npublic final class Main {\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        if (args.length == 0) {\n            String text;\n            try {\n                text = new String(System.in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n            } catch (Exception e) {\n                System.err.println(\"读取标准输入失败: \" + e.getMessage());\n                System.exit(1);\n                return;\n            }\n            boolean ok = runOne(text, \"<stdin>\");\n            System.exit(ok ? 0 : 2);\n        }\n\n        boolean allOk = true;\n        for (int i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {\n            if (args.length > 1) {\n                System.out.println(\"# ===== \" + args[i] + \" =====\");\n            }\n            String text;\n            try {\n                text = java.nio.file.Files.readString(java.nio.file.Path.of(args[i]),\n                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n            } catch (Exception e) {\n                System.out.println(Json.writePretty(errorBody(\"IO_ERROR\",\n                        \"无法读取请求文件: \" + e.getMessage())));\n                allOk = false;\n                continue;\n            }\n            allOk &= runOne(text, args[i]);\n        }\n        System.exit(allOk ? 0 : 2);\n    }\n\n {"parentUuid":"0b1510a1-f177-49f6-a4f7-83c3be08b237","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_yklyghpihhdin8dnnull72am","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/b/tests/windowengine/NaiveReferenceWindow.java","content":"package windowengine;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 朴素逐行窗口参考实现（测试专用）。\n *\n * 刻意与生产引擎走完全不同的代码路径：\n * - 不用 Partitioner / RowComparator / WindowOperator，甚至不依赖 plan 包；\n * - 用冒泡式排序、逐行扫描的 O(n²) 最直白写法；\n * - 每行独立重算自己的分区归属、排名与帧区间和；\n * 生产引擎只要在大量随机场景上与本实现逐格相等，就有较强的正确性证据。\n *\n * 输入数据用 Object[] 行表示：元素只允许 Long / String / null。\n */\npublic final class NaiveReferenceWindow {\n\n    /** 列名 -> 列下标。 */\n    private final Map<String, Integer> columnIndex = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n    private final List<Object[]> rows;\n\n    // 窗口配置\n    private final List<String> partitionCols = new ArrayList<>();\n    private final List<String> orderCols = new ArrayList<>();\n    private final List<Boolean> orderAsc = new ArrayList<>();\n    private final List<Boolean> nullsFirst = new ArrayList<>();\n    // 帧边界：相对当前行的位移语义；用两个标记表示 UNBOUNDED\n    private boolean startUnbounded;\n    private long startDelta;   // // Long/String/null\n    private final Map<String, Integer> index = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n\n    public TestData column(String name, Value.Type type) {\n        if (index.containsKey(name.toLowerCase())) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"重复列: \" + name);\n        }\n        index.put(name.toLowerCase(), columnNames.size());\n        columnNames.add(name);\n        columnTypes.add(type);\n        return this;\n    }\n\n    public TestData row(Object... values) {\n        if (values.length != columnNames.size()) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"列数不符\");\n        }\n        rows.add(values);\n        return this;\n    }\n\n    public int col(String name) {\n        Integer i = index.get(name.toLowerCase());\n        if (i == null) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"无此列: \" + name);\n        }\n        return i;\n    }\n\n    public Object get(int row, String name) {\n        return rows.get(row)[col(name)];\n    }\n\n    public int size() {\n        return rows.size();\n    }\n\n    /** 构造内存关系（走正式 Schema/Row 路径）。 */\n    public Relation toRelation() {\n        Schema schema = new Schema(columnNames, columnTypes);\n        List<Row> rs = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int r = 0; r < rows.size(); r++) {\n            Value[] cells = new Value[schema.size()];\n            for (int c = 0; c < schema.size(); c++) {\n                cells[c] = toValue(rows.get(r)[c]);\n            }\n            rs.add(new Row(cells, r));\n        }\n        return new Relation(schema, rs);\n    }\n\n    static Value toValue(Object o) {\n        if (o == null) {\n            return Value.NULL;\n        }\n        if (o instanceof Long l) {\n            return Value.ofLong(l);\n        }\n        if (o instanceof Integer i) {\n            return Value.ofLong(i.longValue());\n        }\n        if (o instanceof String s) {\n            return Value.ofString(s);\n        }\n        throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"不支持的测试值: \" + o.getClass());\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 组装成请求 JSON 树。\n     *\n     * @param windowNode window 对象（partitionBy/orderBy/frame）\n     * @param functions  函数定义\n     */\n    public Map<String, Object> toRequest(Map<String, Object> windowNode,\n                                         List<Map<String, Object>> functions) {\n        List<Object> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; sumFn(String col, String alias) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"function\", \"SUM\");\n        m.put(\"column\", col);\n        m.put(\"alias\", alias);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> boundObj(String type) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"type\", type);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> boundObj(String type, long offset) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"type\", type);\n        m.put(\"offset\", offset);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> frameObj(Map<String, Object> start, Map<String, Object> end) {\n        Map<String, Object> f = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        f.put(\"mode\", \"ROWS\");\n        f.put(\"start\", start);\n        f.put(\"end\", end);\n        return f;\n    }\n\n    private record Executed(Relation result, Map<String, Integer> outputIndex) {\n        Value cell(int row, String alias) {\n            return result.rows().get(row).get(outputIndex.get(alias.toLowerCase()));\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 走“JSON 树 -> RequestParser -> WindowEngine”正式链路。 */\n    private static Executed runRequest(Map<String, Object> request) {\n        QueryRequest qr = new RequestParser().parse(request);\n        Relation result = new WindowEngine().execute(qr);\n        Map<String, Integer> idx = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < result.schema().size(); i++) {\n            idx.put(result.schema().name(i).toLowerCase(), i);\n        }\n        return new Executed(result, idx);\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 1：ROW_NUMBER / RANK 并列语义 ----------\n\n    public void testRankAndRowNumberTies() {\n        // 成绩并列：两个 90 并列第 1，80 排第 3；ROW_NUMBER 必须连续不并列\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"id\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"score\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(1L, 90L)\n                .row(2L, 90L)\n                .row(3L, 80L)\n                .row(4L, 90L)\n                .row(5L, null)\n                .row(6L, 70L);\n\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"score\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n\n        // 排序后顺序：NULL(行4) -> 70(行5) -> 80(行2) -> 90(行0) -> 90(行1) -> 90(行3)\n        // 按 sourceIndex 回原行检查\n        Long[] expectRnkBySource = {4L, 4L, 3L, 4L, 1L, 2L};\n        Long[] expectRnBySource = {4L, 5L, 3L, 6L, 1L, 2L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expectRnkBySource[i], ex.cell(i, \"rk\").asLong(),\n                    \"RANK 行 \" + i);\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expectRnBySource[i], ex.cell(i, \"rn\").asLong(),\n                    \"ROW_NUMBER 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 2：并列打破的确定性（相等键按输入序） ----------\n\n    public void testRowNumberTieBreakIsStableByInputOrder() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"k\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(5L, 100L)\n                .row(5L, 101L)\n                .row(5L, 102L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"k\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        // 三行键完全相等：RANK 全 1；ROW_NUMBER 必须严格按原始输入顺序 1,2,3\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(1L, ex.cell(i, \"rk\").asLong(), \"完全并列时 RANK 全 1，行 \" + i);\n            Asserts.assertEquals((long) (i + 1), ex.cell(i, \"rn\").asLong(),\n                    \"ROW_NUMBER 按输入序，行 \" + i);\n            Asserts.assertEquals(100L + i, ex.cell(i, \"v\").asLong(), \"输出行序应保持输入序\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 3：分区 + 单行分区 ----------\n\n    public void testPartitionAndSingleRowPartition() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"dept\", Value.Type.STRING)\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(\"A\", 10L)\n                .row(\"B\", 99L)\n                .row(\"A\", 20L)\n                .row(\"C\", 5L)\n                .row(\"A\", 30L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"partitionBy\", List.of(\"dept\"));\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        // 按输入行：A:10,A:20,A:30 与 B/C 各自独立编号\n        long[] expectRn = {1L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 3L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expectRn[i], ex.cell(i, \"rn\").asLong(),\n                    \"分区 ROW_NUMBER 行 \" + i);\n            Asserts.assertEquals(1L, ex.cell(i, \"rk\").asLong(), \"无并列时 RANK 等于序号\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 4：滑动窗口越界裁剪 ----------\n\n    public void testSlidingFrameOutOfBounds() {\n        // ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING，首行无前值、末行无后值\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n win.put(\"frame\", frameObj(boundObj(\"PRECEDING\", 1), boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 1)));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        Executed ex = \"1 PRECEDING..1 FOLLOWING 滑动和 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 5：大偏移导致空帧 ----------\n\n    public void testEmptyFrameWhenStartAfterEnd() {\n        // ROWS BETWEEN 5 FOLLOWING        \"负值累计和 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 7：NULL 输入忽略 + 全 NULL 帧 ----------\n\n    public void testNullsInSumIgnoredAndAllNullFrame() {\n        TestData d = new win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"LAST\")));\n        win.put(\"frame\", frameObj(boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\"), boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = Asserts.assertTrue(ex.cell(4, \"s\").isNull(), \"NULL 行 CURRENT ROW 帧应为 NULL\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 8：DESC + 显式 NULLS FIRST ----------\n\n    public void testDescWithNullsFirst() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(3L).row(null).row(1L).row(3L).row(2L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"DESC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", Asserts.assertEquals(sumBySource[i], ex.cell(i, \"s\").asLong(),\n                    \"无 ORDER BY SUM 为全分区和\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 12：UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING 帧 ----------\n\n }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 13：溢出检测 ----------\n\n    public void testOverflowDetected() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(Long.MAX_VALUE).row(1L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        win.put(\"frame\", frameObj(boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\"), boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        try {\n            runRequest(req);\n            Asserts.fail(\"MAX+1 应触发 OVERFLOW\");\n        } catch (EngineException e) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.OVERFLOW.code(), e.code(), \"错误码应为 OVERFLOW\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void testNegativeOverflowDetected() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n
