frameObj(boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\"), boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        try {\n            runRequest(req);\n            Asserts.fail(\"MIN-1 应触发 OVERFLOW\");\n        } catch (EngineException e) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.OVERFLOW.code(), e.code(), \"负向溢出也应被捕获\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 14：NULL 分区键聚到同一组 ----------\n\n    public void testNullPartitionKeysGroupTogether() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"p\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(null, 1L).row(null, 2L).row(1L, 9L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"partitionBy\", List.of(\"p\"));\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        long[] expect = {1L, 2L, 1L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expect[i], ex.cell(i, \"rn\").asLong(),\n                    \"NULL 分区键应同组 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // =====================================================================\n    // 随机差分测试：生产引擎 vs 朴素参考\n    // =====================================================================\n\n    public void testRandomDifferentialAgainstNaiveReference() {\n        Random rnd = new Random(20260923L);\n        int scenarios = 300;\n        for (int s = 0; s < scenarios; s++) {\n            runOneRandomScenario(rnd, s);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void runOneRandomScenario(Random rnd, int scenarioId) {\n        int n = 1 + rnd.nextInt(24); // 1..24 行（含单行分区/空帧的大量机会）\n\n        // 列：p1/p2 分区键（LONG/STRING，可空），o 排序键，v SUM 参数\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"p1\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"p2\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"o\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG);\n\n        // 控制取值域，制造大量并列 / NULL\n        long[] domain = {-5L, -1L, 0L, 1L, 5L, null};\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Object p1 = maybeNullSmall(rnd);\n            Object p2 = rnd.nextInt(3) == 0 ? maybeNullSmall(rnd) : 0L; // p2 常重复\n            Object o = pick(domain, rnd);\n            Object v;\n            int vr = rnd.nextInt(10);\n            if (vr == 0) {\n                v = null;\n            } else if (vr == 1) {\n                v = (long) (rnd.nextInt(40) - 20); // 稍大一点的值\n            } else {\n                v = pick(domain, rnd);\n            }\n            d.row(p1, p2, o, v);\n        }\n\n        boolean hasPartition = rnd.nextInt(4) != 0;\n        String[] parts = hasPartition\n                ? (rnd.nextBoolean() ? new String[]{\"p1\"} : new String[]{\"p1\", \"p2\"})\n                : new String[]{};\n\n        boolean asc = rnd.nextBoolean();\n        boolean nullFirst = rnd.nextBoolean();\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"partitionBy\", List.of(parts));\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"o\", asc ? \"ASC\" : \"DESC\",\n                nullFirst ? \"FIRST\" : \"LAST\")));\n\n        // 随机帧：覆盖各种越界/空帧/无界组合\n        int frameKind = rnd.nextInt(8);\n        Map<String, Object> startBound;\n        Map<String, Object> endBound;\n        long refStartDelta;\n        long refEndDelta;\n        boolean refStartUnbounded = false;\n        boolean refEndUnbounded = false;\n\n        switch (frameKind) {\n            case 0 -> { // 1 PRECEDING .. 1 FOLLOWING\n                startBound = boundObj(\"PRECEDING\", 1);\n                endBound = boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 1);\n                refStartDelta = -1;\n                refEndDelta = 1;\n            }\n            case 1 -> { // 3 PRECEDING .. CURRENT ROW\n                startBound = boundObj(\"PRECEDING\", 3);\n                endBound = boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\");\n                refStartDelta = -3;\n                refEndDelta = 0;\n            }\n            case 2 -> { // CURRENT ROW .. 2 FOLLOWING\n                startBound = boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\");\n                endBound = boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 2);\n                refStartDelta = 0;\n                refEndDelta = 2;\n            }\n            case 3 -> { // UNBOUNDED PRECEDING .. CURRENT ROW（累计）\n                startBound = boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\");\n                endBound = boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\");\n                refStartUnbounded = true;\n                refStartDelta = Long.MIN_VALUE;\n                refEndDelta = 0;\n            }\n            case 4 -> { // CURRENT ROW .. UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING\n                startBound = boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\");\n                endBound = boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING\");\n                refStartDelta = 0;\n                refEndUnbounded = true;\n                refEndDelta = Long.MAX_VALUE;\n            }\n            case 5 -> { // 整个分区\n                startBound = boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\");\n                endBound = boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING\");\n                refStartUnbounded = true;\n                refEndUnbounded = true;\n                refStartDelta = Long.MIN_VALUE;\n                refEndDelta = Long.MAX_VALUE;\n            }\n            case 6 -> { // 大偏移，构造大量空帧：5 FOLLOWING .. 8 FOLLOWING\n                startBound = boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 5);\n                endBound = boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 8);\n                refStartDelta = 5;\n                refEndDelta = 8;\n            }\n            default -> { // 2 PRECEDING .. 4 PRECEDING 非法（起点晚于终点）-> 请求应被拒绝\n                Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(\n                        withFrame(win, frameObj(boundObj(\"PRECEDING\", 2), boundObj(\"PRECEDING\", 4))),\n                        List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\"), sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n                try {\n                    runRequest(req);\n                    Asserts.fail(\"场景 \" + scenarioId + \"：非法帧 2 PRECEDING..4 PRECEDING 必须报错\");\n                } catch (EngineException e) {\n                    Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME.code(), e.code(),\n                            \"非法帧错误码\");\n                }\n                return;\n            }\n        }\n        win.put(\"frame\", frameObj(startBound, endBound));\n\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\"), sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n\n        // ---- 朴素参考 ----\n        NaiveReferenceWindow ref = NaiveReferenceWindow.of(d.columnNames, d.rows)\n                .partitionBy(parts)\n                .orderBy(\"o\", asc, nullFirst)\n                .sumColumn(\"v\");\n        if (refStartUnbounded && refEndUnbounded) {\n            ref.frameWholePartition();\n        } else if (refStartUnbounded) {\n            ref.frameUnboundedTo(refEndDelta);\n        } else if (refEndUnbounded) {\n            ref.frameFromToUnbounded(refStartDelta);\n        } else {\n            ref.frame(refStartDelta, refEndDelta);\n        }\n        List<Object[]> naive = ref.compute();\n\n        // ---- 逐格比较 ----\n        Asserts.assertEquals(d.size(), ex.result.rowCount(), \"场景 \" + scenarioId + \" 行数\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < d.size(); i++) {\n            Value rn = ex.cell(i, \"rn\");\n            Value rk = ex.cell(i, \"rk\");\n            Value sm = ex.cell(i, \"s\");\n            Object[] expect = naive.get(i);\n            String ctx = \"场景 \" + scenarioId + \" 行 \" + i\n                    + \"（n=\" + n + \", asc=\" + asc + \", nullFirst=\" + nullFirst\n                    + \", frame=\" + frameKind + \"）\";\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expect[0], rn.asLong(), ctx + \" ROW_NUMBER\");\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expect[1], rk.asLong(), ctx + \" RANK\");\n            if (expect[2] == null) {\n                Asserts.assertTrue(sm.isNull(), ctx + \" SUM 应为 NULL\");\n            } else {\n                Asserts.assertFalse(sm.isNull(), ctx + \" SUM 不应为 NULL\");\n                Asserts.assertEquals(expect[2], sm.asLong(), ctx + \" SUM\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> withFrame(Map<String, Object> win,\n                                                 Map<String, Object> frame) {\n        win.put(\"frame\", frame);\n        return win;\n    }\n\n    private static Object maybeNullSmall(Random rnd) {\n        int x = rnd.nextInt(5);\n        return x == 0 ? null : (long) (x - 2); // null,-1,0,1,2\n    }\n\n    private static Object pick(long[] values, Random rnd) {\n        Object v = values[rnd.nextInt(values.length)];\n        return v; // 数组里的 null 元素即 null\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_0c2e0f67617cfdc089061bc0","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1322,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":69432,"output_tokens":7613,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_h9fvf7la0s2qm36z6u5jscri":{"content":"package windowengine;\n\nimport windowengine.engine.WindowEngine;\nimport windowengine.plan.QueryPlan;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.Random;\n\n/**\n * 窗口引擎核心测试：\n * 1. 固定边界用例（并列键、单行分区、窗口越界、负值、NULL 顺序、空帧、全 NULL 帧）；\n * 2. 大规模随机差分测试：生产引擎 vs 朴素逐行参考实现，逐行逐列比较。\n */\npublic final class WindowEngineTest {\n\n    // ---------- 测试辅助 ----------\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> orderEntry(String col, String dir, String nullOrder) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"column\", col);\n        m.put(\"direction\", dir);\n        m.put(\"nullOrder\", nullOrder);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> fn(String fn, String alias) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"function\", fn);\n        m.put(\"alias\", alias);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> sumFn(String col, String alias) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"function\", \"SUM\");\n        m.put(\"column\", col);\n        m.put(\"alias\", alias);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> boundObj(String type) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"type\", type);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> boundObj(String type, long offset) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"type\", type);\n        m.put(\"offset\", offset);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> frameObj(Map<String, Object> start, Map<String, Object> end) {\n        Map<String, Object> f = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        f.put(\"mode\", \"ROWS\");\n        f.put(\"start\", start);\n        f.put(\"end\", end);\n        return f;\n    }\n\n    private record Executed(Relation result, Map<String, Integer> outputIndex) {\n        Value cell(int row, String alias) {\n            return result.rows().get(row).get(outputIndex.get(alias.toLowerCase()));\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 走“JSON 树 -> RequestParser -> WindowEngine”正式链路。 */\n    private static Executed runRequest(Map<String, Object> request) {\n        QueryRequest qr = new RequestParser().parse(request);\n        Relation result = new WindowEngine().execute(qr);\n        Map<String, Integer> idx = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < result.schema().size(); i++) {\n            idx.put(result.schema().name(i).toLowerCase(), i);\n        }\n        return new Executed(result, idx);\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 1：ROW_NUMBER / RANK 并列语义 ----------\n\n    public void testRankAndRowNumberTies() {\n        // 成绩并列：两个 90 并列第 1，80 排第 3；ROW_NUMBER 必须连续不并列\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"id\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"score\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(1L, 90L)\n                .row(2L, 90L)\n                .row(3L, 80L)\n                .row(4L, 90L)\n                .row(5L, null)\n                .row(6L, 70L);\n\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"score\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n\n        // 排序后顺序：NULL(行4) -> 70(行5) -> 80(行2) -> 90(行0) -> 90(行1) -> 90(行3)\n        // 按 sourceIndex 回原行检查\n        Long[] expectRnkBySource = {4L, 4L, 3L, 4L, 1L, 2L};\n        Long[] expectRnBySource = {4L, 5L, 3L, 6L, 1L, 2L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expectRnkBySource[i], ex.cell(i, \"rk\").asLong(),\n                    \"RANK 行 \" + i);\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expectRnBySource[i], ex.cell(i, \"rn\").asLong(),\n                    \"ROW_NUMBER 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 2：并列打破的确定性（相等键按输入序） ----------\n\n    public void testRowNumberTieBreakIsStableByInputOrder() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"k\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(5L, 100L)\n                .row(5L, 101L)\n                .row(5L, 102L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"k\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        // 三行键完全相等：RANK 全 1；ROW_NUMBER 必须严格按原始输入顺序 1,2,3\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(1L, ex.cell(i, \"rk\").asLong(), \"完全并列时 RANK 全 1，行 \" + i);\n            Asserts.assertEquals((long) (i + 1), ex.cell(i, \"rn\").asLong(),\n                    \"ROW_NUMBER 按输入序，行 \" + i);\n            Asserts.assertEquals(100L + i, ex.cell(i, \"v\").asLong(), \"输出行序应保持输入序\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 3：分区 + 单行分区 ----------\n\n    public void testPartitionAndSingleRowPartition() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"dept\", Value.Type.STRING)\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(\"A\", 10L)\n                .row(\"B\", 99L)\n                .row(\"A\", 20L)\n                .row(\"C\", 5L)\n                .row(\"A\", 30L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"partitionBy\", List.of(\"dept\"));\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        // 按输入行：A:10,A:20,A:30 与 B/C 各自独立编号\n        long[] expectRn = {1L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 3L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expectRn[i], ex.cell(i, \"rn\").asLong(),\n                    \"分区 ROW_NUMBER 行 \" + i);\n            Asserts.assertEquals(1L, ex.cell(i, \"rk\").asLong(), \"无并列时 RANK 等于序号\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 4：滑动窗口越界裁剪 ----------\n\n    public void testSlidingFrameOutOfBounds() {\n        // ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING，首行无前值、末行无后值\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(1L).row(2L).row(3L).row(4L).row(5L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        win.put(\"frame\", frameObj(boundObj(\"PRECEDING\", 1), boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 1)));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        long[] expect = {3L, 6L, 9L, 12L, 9L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expect[i], ex.cell(i, \"s\").asLong(),\n                    \"1 PRECEDING..1 FOLLOWING 滑动和 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 5：大偏移导致空帧 ----------\n\n    public void testEmptyFrameWhenStartAfterEnd() {\n        // ROWS BETWEEN 5 FOLLOWING AND 10 FOLLOWING：5 行分区里帧完全在分区之后 -> 空帧 NULL\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(1L).row(2L).row(3L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        win.put(\"frame\", frameObj(boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 5), boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 10)));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertTrue(ex.cell(i, \"s\").isNull(), \"帧完全越界应为 NULL，行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 6：负值求和 ----------\n\n    public void testNegativeValuesSum() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(-10L).row(4L).row(-7L).row(0L).row(13L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        // 默认帧（累计到当前行）\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(sumFn(\"v\", \"cum\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        long[] expect = {-10L, -6L, -13L, -13L, 0L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expect[i], ex.cell(i, \"cum\").asLong(),\n                    \"负值累计和 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 7：NULL 输入忽略 + 全 NULL 帧 ----------\n\n    public void testNullsInSumIgnoredAndAllNullFrame() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(null).row(5L).row(null).row(7L).row(null);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"LAST\")));\n        win.put(\"frame\", frameObj(boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\"), boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        // 排序后三个 NULL 排最后；CURRENT ROW 帧：NULL 行 -> NULL，非 NULL 行 -> 自身值\n        // 输入行 0,2,4 为 NULL -> NULL；行1=5；行3=7\n        Asserts.assertTrue(ex.cell(0, \"s\").isNull(), \"NULL 行 CURRENT ROW 帧应为 NULL\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(5L, ex.cell(1, \"s\").asLong(), \"非 NULL 行帧和为自身\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(ex.cell(2, \"s\").isNull(), \"NULL 行 CURRENT ROW 帧应为 NULL\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(7L, ex.cell(3, \"s\").asLong(), \"非 NULL 行帧和为自身\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(ex.cell(4, \"s\").isNull(), \"NULL 行 CURRENT ROW 帧应为 NULL\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 8：DESC + 显式 NULLS FIRST ----------\n\n    public void testDescWithNullsFirst() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(3L).row(null).row(1L).row(3L).row(2L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"DESC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        // 排序：NULL(source1) -> 3(s0) -> 3(s3) -> 2(s4) -> 1(s2)\n        long[] rnBySource = {2L, 1L, 5L, 3L, 4L};\n        long[] rkBySource = {2L, 1L, 5L, 2L, 4L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(rnBySource[i], ex.cell(i, \"rn\").asLong(),\n                    \"DESC NULLS FIRST RN 行 \" + i);\n            Asserts.assertEquals(rkBySource[i], ex.cell(i, \"rk\").asLong(),\n                    \"DESC NULLS FIRST RANK 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 9：多列排序键上的并列 ----------\n\n    public void testMultiKeyTies() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"a\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"b\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(1L, 1L)\n                .row(1L, 1L)\n                .row(1L, 2L)\n                .row(2L, 1L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(\n                orderEntry(\"a\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\"),\n                orderEntry(\"b\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        long[] expect = {1L, 1L, 3L, 4L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expect[i], ex.cell(i, \"rk\").asLong(),\n                    \"多列键 RANK 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 10：空表 ----------\n\n    public void testEmptyTable() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\"), sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        Asserts.assertEquals(0, ex.result.rowCount(), \"空表结果应为 0 行\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(4, ex.result.schema().size(), \"输出 schema 仍应追加 3 列\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 11：无 ORDER BY 时整个分区一个排名 + 全分区 SUM ----------\n\n    public void testNoOrderByWholePartition() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"p\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(1L, 5L).row(2L, 7L).row(1L, 3L).row(2L, 1L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"partitionBy\", List.of(\"p\"));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\"), sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        // 无 ORDER BY：RANK 全 1；SUM 默认为整个分区\n        long[] sumBySource = {8L, 8L, 8L, 8L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(1L, ex.cell(i, \"rk\").asLong(), \"无 ORDER BY RANK 恒 1\");\n            Asserts.assertEquals(sumBySource[i], ex.cell(i, \"s\").asLong(),\n                    \"无 ORDER BY SUM 为全分区和\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 12：UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING 帧 ----------\n\n    public void testFrameToUnboundedFollowing() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(1L).row(2L).row(3L).row(4L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        win.put(\"frame\", frameObj(boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\"), boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        long[] expect = {10L, 9L, 7L, 4L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expect[i], ex.cell(i, \"s\").asLong(),\n                    \"CURRENT ROW..UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 13：溢出检测 ----------\n\n    public void testOverflowDetected() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(Long.MAX_VALUE).row(1L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        win.put(\"frame\", frameObj(boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\"), boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        try {\n            runRequest(req);\n            Asserts.fail(\"MAX+1 应触发 OVERFLOW\");\n        } catch (EngineException e) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.OVERFLOW.code(), e.code(), \"错误码应为 OVERFLOW\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void testNegativeOverflowDetected() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(Long.MIN_VALUE).row(-1L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        win.put(\"frame\", frameObj(boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\"), boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        try {\n            runRequest(req);\n            Asserts.fail(\"MIN-1 应触发 OVERFLOW\");\n        } catch (EngineException e) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.OVERFLOW.code(), e.code(), \"负向溢出也应被捕获\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 14：NULL 分区键聚到同一组 ----------\n\n    public void testNullPartitionKeysGroupTogether() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"p\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(null, 1L).row(null, 2L).row(1L, 9L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"partitionBy\", List.of(\"p\"));\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win, List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        long[] expect = {1L, 2L, 1L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expect[i], ex.cell(i, \"rn\").asLong(),\n                    \"NULL 分区键应同组 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // =====================================================================\n    // 随机差分测试：生产引擎 vs 朴素参考\n    // =====================================================================\n\n    public void testRandomDifferentialAgainstNaiveReference() {\n        Random rnd = new Random(20260923L);\n        int scenarios = 300;\n        for (int s = 0; s < scenarios; s++) {\n            runOneRandomScenario(rnd, s);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void runOneRandomScenario(Random rnd, int scenarioId) {\n        int n = 1 + rnd.nextInt(24); // 1..24 行（含单行分区/空帧的大量机会）\n\n        // 列：p1/p2 分区键（LONG/STRING，可空），o 排序键，v SUM 参数\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"p1\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"p2\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"o\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG);\n\n        // 控制取值域，制造大量并列 / NULL\n        long[] domain = {-5L, -1L, 0L, 1L, 5L, null};\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Object p1 = maybeNullSmall(rnd);\n            Object p2 = rnd.nextInt(3) == 0 ? maybeNullSmall(rnd) : 0L; // p2 常重复\n            Object o = pick(domain, rnd);\n            Object v;\n            int vr = rnd.nextInt(10);\n            if (vr == 0) {\n                v = null;\n            } else if (vr == 1) {\n                v = (long) (rnd.nextInt(40) - 20); // 稍大一点的值\n            } else {\n                v = pick(domain, rnd);\n            }\n            d.row(p1, p2, o, v);\n        }\n\n        boolean hasPartition = rnd.nextInt(4) != 0;\n        String[] parts = hasPartition\n                ? (rnd.nextBoolean() ? new String[]{\"p1\"} : new String[]{\"p1\", \"p2\"})\n                : new String[]{};\n\n        boolean asc = rnd.nextBoolean();\n        boolean nullFirst = rnd.nextBoolean();\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"partitionBy\", List.of(parts));\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"o\", asc ? \"ASC\" : \"DESC\",\n                nullFirst ? \"FIRST\" : \"LAST\")));\n\n        // 随机帧：覆盖各种越界/空帧/无界组合\n        int frameKind = rnd.nextInt(8);\n        Map<String, Object> startBound;\n        Map<String, Object> endBound;\n        long refStartDelta;\n        long refEndDelta;\n        boolean refStartUnbounded = false;\n        boolean refEndUnbounded = false;\n\n        switch (frameKind) {\n            case 0 -> { // 1 PRECEDING .. 1 FOLLOWING\n                startBound = boundObj(\"PRECEDING\", 1);\n                endBound = boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 1);\n                refStartDelta = -1;\n                refEndDelta = 1;\n            }\n            case 1 -> { // 3 PRECEDING .. CURRENT ROW\n                startBound = boundObj(\"PRECEDING\", 3);\n                endBound = boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\");\n                refStartDelta = -3;\n                refEndDelta = 0;\n            }\n            case 2 -> { // CURRENT ROW .. 2 FOLLOWING\n                startBound = boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\");\n                endBound = boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 2);\n                refStartDelta = 0;\n                refEndDelta = 2;\n            }\n            case 3 -> { // UNBOUNDED PRECEDING .. CURRENT ROW（累计）\n                startBound = boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\");\n                endBound = boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\");\n                refStartUnbounded = true;\n                refStartDelta = Long.MIN_VALUE;\n                refEndDelta = 0;\n            }\n            case 4 -> { // CURRENT ROW .. UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING\n                startBound = boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\");\n                endBound = boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING\");\n                refStartDelta = 0;\n                refEndUnbounded = true;\n                refEndDelta = Long.MAX_VALUE;\n            }\n            case 5 -> { // 整个分区\n                startBound = boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\");\n                endBound = boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING\");\n                refStartUnbounded = true;\n                refEndUnbounded = true;\n                refStartDelta = Long.MIN_VALUE;\n                refEndDelta = Long.MAX_VALUE;\n            }\n            case 6 -> { // 大偏移，构造大量空帧：5 FOLLOWING .. 8 FOLLOWING\n                startBound = boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 5);\n                endBound = boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 8);\n                refStartDelta = 5;\n                refEndDelta = 8;\n            }\n            default -> { // 2 PRECEDING .. 4 PRECEDING 非法（起点晚于终点）-> 请求应被拒绝\n m.put(\"column\", col);\n        m.put(\"direction\", dir);\n        m.put(\"nullOrder\", nullOrder);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> fn(String fn, String alias) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"function\", fn);\n        m.put(\"alias\", alias);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object>     return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> boundObj(String type) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"type\", type);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> boundObj(String type, long offset) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"type\", type);\n        m.put(\"offset\", offset);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> frameObj(Map<String, Object> start, Map<String, Object> end) {\n        Map<String, Object> f = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        f.put(\"mode\", \"ROWS\");\n        f.put(\"start\", start);\n        f.put(\"end\", end);\n        return f;\n    }\n\n    private record Executed(Relation result, Map<String, Integer> outputIndex) {\n        Value cell(int row, String alias) {\n            return result.rows().get(row).get(outputIndex.get(alias.toLowerCase()));\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 走“JSON 树 -> RequestParser -> WindowEngine”正式链路。 */\n    private static Executed runRequest(Map<String, Object> request) {\n        QueryRequest qr = new RequestParser().parse(request);\n        Relation result = new WindowEngine().execute(qr);\n        Map<String, Integer> idx = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < result.schema().size(); i++) {\n            idx.put(result.schema().name(i).toLowerCase(), i);\n        }\n        return new Executed(result, idx);\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 1：ROW_NUMBER / RANK 并列语义 ----------\n\n    public void testRankAndRowNumberTies() {\n        // 成绩并列：两个 90 并列第 1，80 排第 3；ROW_NUMBER 必须连续不并列\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"id\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"score\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(1L, 90L)\n                .row(2L, 90L)\n                .row(3L, 80L)\n                .row(4L, 90L)\n                .row(5L, null)\n                .row(6L, 70L);\n\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"score\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n\n        // 排序后顺序：NULL(行4) -> 70(行5) -> 80(行2) -> 90(行0) -> 90(行1) -> 90(行3)\n        // 按 sourceIndex 回原行检查\n        Long[] expectRnkBySource = {4L, 4L, 3L, 4L, 1L, 2L};\n        Long[] expectRnBySource = {4L, 5L, 3L, 6L, 1L, 2L};\n        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expectRnkBySource[i], ex.cell(i, \"rk\").asLong(),\n                    \"RANK 行 \" + i);\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expectRnBySource[i], ex.cell(i, \"rn\").asLong(),\n                    \"ROW_NUMBER 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 2：并列打破的确定性（相等键按输入序） ----------\n\n    public void testRowNumberTieBreakIsStableByInputOrder() {\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"k\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .row(5L, 100L)\n                .row(5L, 101L)\n                .row(5L, 102L);\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"k\", \"ASC\", \"FIRST\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        // 三行键完全相等：RANK 全 1；ROW_NUMBER 必须严格按原始输入顺序      Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n        // 按输入行：A:10,A:20,A:30 与        \"负值累计和 行 \" + i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 固定用例 7：NULL 输入忽略 + 全 NULL 帧 ----------\n\n    public void testNullsInSumIgnoredAndAllNullFrame() {\n        TestData d = new win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"v\", \"ASC\", \"LAST\")));\n        win.put(\"frame\", frameObj(boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\"), boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = scenarios = 300;\n        for (int s = 0; s < scenarios; s++) {\n            runOneRandomScenario(rnd, s);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void runOneRandomScenario(Random rnd, int scenarioId) {\n        int n = 1 + rnd.nextInt(24); // 1..24 行（含单行分区/空帧的大量机会）\n\n        // 列：p1/p2 分区键（LONG/STRING，可空），o 排序键，v SUM 参数\n        TestData d = new TestData()\n                .column(\"p1\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"p2\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"o\", Value.Type.LONG)\n                .column(\"v\", Value.Type.LONG);\n\n        // 控制取值域，制造大量并列 / NULL\n        long[] domain = {-5L, -1L, 0L, 1L, 5L, null};\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Object p1 = maybeNullSmall(rnd);\n            Object p2 = rnd.nextInt(3) == 0 ? maybeNullSmall(rnd) : 0L; // p2 常重复\n            Object o = pick(domain, rnd);\n            Object v;\n            int vr = rnd.nextInt(10);\n            if (vr == 0) {\n                v = null;\n            } else if (vr == 1) {\n                v = (long) (rnd.nextInt(40) - 20); // 稍大一点的值\n            } else {\n                v = pick(domain, rnd);\n            }\n            d.row(p1, p2, o, v);\n        }\n\n        boolean hasPartition = rnd.nextInt(4) != 0;\n        String[] parts = hasPartition\n                ? (rnd.nextBoolean() ? new String[]{\"p1\"} : new String[]{\"p1\", \"p2\"})\n                : new String[]{};\n\n        boolean asc = rnd.nextBoolean();\n        boolean nullFirst = rnd.nextBoolean();\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"partitionBy\", List.of(parts));\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(orderEntry(\"o\", asc ? \"ASC\" : \"DESC\",\n                nullFirst ? \"FIRST\" : \"LAST\")));\n\n        // 随机帧：覆盖各种越界/空帧/无界组合\n        int frameKind = rnd.nextInt(8);\n        Map<String, Object> startBound;\n        Map<String, Object> endBound;\n        long refStartDelta;\n        long refEndDelta;\n        boolean refStartUnbounded = false;\n        boolean refEndUnbounded = false;\n\n        switch (frameKind) {\n            case 0 -> { // 1 PRECEDING .. 1 FOLLOWING\n                startBound = boundObj(\"PRECEDING\", 1);\n                endBound = boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 1);\n                refStartDelta = -1;\n                refEndDelta = 1;\n            }\n            case 1 -> { // 3 PRECEDING .. CURRENT ROW\n                startBound = boundObj(\"PRECEDING\", 3);\n                endBound = boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\");\n                refStartDelta = -3;\n                refEndDelta = 0;\n            }\n            case 2 -> { // CURRENT ROW .. 2 FOLLOWING\n                startBound = boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\");\n                endBound = boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 2);\n                refStartDelta = 0;\n                refEndDelta = 2;\n            }\n            case 3 -> { // UNBOUNDED PRECEDING .. CURRENT ROW（累计）\n                startBound = boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\");\n                endBound = boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\");\n                refStartUnbounded = true;\n                refStartDelta = Long.MIN_VALUE;\n                refEndDelta = 0;\n            }\n            case 4 -> { // CURRENT ROW .. UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING\n                startBound = boundObj(\"CURRENT_ROW\");\n                endBound = boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING\");\n                refStartDelta = 0;\n                refEndUnbounded = true;\n                refEndDelta = Long.MAX_VALUE;\n            }\n            case 5 -> { // 整个分区\n                startBound = boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\");\n                endBound = boundObj(\"UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING\");\n                refStartUnbounded = true;\n                refEndUnbounded = true;\n                refStartDelta = Long.MIN_VALUE;\n                refEndDelta = Long.MAX_VALUE;\n            }\n            case 6 -> { // 大偏移，构造大量空帧：5 FOLLOWING .. 8 FOLLOWING\n                startBound = boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 5);\n                endBound = boundObj(\"FOLLOWING\", 8);\n                refStartDelta = 5;\n                refEndDelta = 8;\n            }\n            default -> { // 2 PRECEDING .. 4 PRECEDING 非法（起点晚于终点）-> 请求应被拒绝\n                Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(\n                        withFrame(win, frameObj(boundObj(\"PRECEDING\", 2), boundObj(\"PRECEDING\", 4))),\n                        List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\"), sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n                try {\n                    runRequest(req);\n                    Asserts.fail(\"场景 \" + scenarioId + \"：非法帧 2 PRECEDING..4 PRECEDING 必须报错\");\n                } catch (EngineException e) {\n                    Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME.code(), e.code(),\n                            \"非法帧错误码\");\n                }\n                return;\n            }\n        }\n        win.put(\"frame\", frameObj(startBound, endBound));\n\n        Map<String, Object> req = d.toRequest(win,\n                List.of(fn(\"ROW_NUMBER\", \"rn\"), fn(\"RANK\", \"rk\"), sumFn(\"v\", \"s\")));\n        Executed ex = runRequest(req);\n\n        // ---- 朴素参考 ----\n        NaiveReferenceWindow ref = NaiveReferenceWindow.of(d.columnNames, d.rows)\n                .partitionBy(parts)\n                .orderBy(\"o\", asc, nullFirst)\n                .sumColumn(\"v\");\n        if (refStartUnbounded && refEndUnbounded) {\n            ref.frameWholePartition();\n        } else if (refStartUnbounded) {\n            ref.frameUnboundedTo(refEndDelta);\n        } else if (refEndUnbounded) {\n            ref.frameFromToUnbounded(refStartDelta);\n        } else {\n            ref.frame(refStartDelta, refEndDelta);\n        }\n        List<Object[]> naive = ref.compute();\n\n        // ---- 逐格比较 ----\n        Asserts.assertEquals(d.size(), ex.result.rowCount(), \"场景 \" + scenarioId + \" 行数\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < d.size(); i++) {\n            Value rn = ex.cell(i, \"rn\");\n            Value rk = ex.cell(i, \"rk\");\n            Value sm = ex.cell(i, \"s\");\n            Object[] expect = naive.get(i);\n            String ctx = \"场景 \" + scenarioId + \" 行 \" + i\n                    + \"（n=\" + n + \", asc=\" + asc + \", nullFirst=\" + nullFirst\n                    + \", frame=\" + frameKind + \"）\";\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expect[0], rn.asLong(), ctx + \" ROW_NUMBER\");\n            Asserts.assertEquals(expect[1], rk.asLong(), ctx + \" RANK\");\n            if (expect[2] == null) {\n                Asserts.assertTrue(sm.isNull(), ctx + \" SUM 应为 NULL\");\n            } else {\n                Asserts.assertFalse(sm.isNull(), ctx + \" SUM 不应为 NULL\");\n                Asserts.assertEquals(expect[2], sm.asLong(), ctx + \" SUM\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> withFrame(Map<String, Object> win,\n                                                 Map<String, Object> frame) {\n        win.put(\"frame\", frame);\n        return win;\n    }\n\n    private static Object maybeNullSmall(Random rnd) {\n        int x = rnd.nextInt(5);\n        return x == 0 ? null : (long) (x - 2); // null,-1,0,1,2\n    }\n\n    private static Object pick(long[] values, Random rnd) {\n        Object v = values[rnd.nextInt(values.length)];\n        return v; // 数组里的 null 元素即 null\n windowengine;\n\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * RequestParser 语义校验与 JSON 解析测试：列不存在、重名、非法帧、\n * 类型不匹配、默认帧/默认 NULL 顺序展开、帧文本解析等。\n */\npublic final class RequestParserTest {\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> simpleRequest() {\n        Map<String, Object> data = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        data.put(\"columns\", List.of(\"a\", \"b\")); // 裸列名，默认 LONG\n        data.put(\"rows\", List.of(List.of(1L, 2L), List.of(3L, null)));\n\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(\"a\")); // 裸字符串排序键\n        Map<String, Object> plan = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        plan.put(\"window\", win);\n        plan.put(\"functions\", List.of(Map.of(\"function\", \"ROW_NUMBER\", \"alias\", \"rn\")));\n\n        Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        req.put(\"data\", data);\n        req.put(\"plan\", plan);\n        return req;\n    }\n\n    private static QueryRequest parse(Map<String, Object> req) {\n        return new RequestParser().parse(req);\n    }\n\n    private static EngineException expectError(Runnable action, String label) {\n        try {\n            action.run();\n        } catch (EngineException e) {\n            return e;\n        }\n        throw new AssertionError(label + \"：应当抛出 EngineException\");\n    }\n\n    public void testMinimalRequestParses() {\n        QueryRequest qr = parse(simpleRequest());\n        Asserts.assertEquals(2, qr.data().schema().size(), \"2 个输入列\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(Value.Type.LONG, qr.data().schema().type(1), \"裸列默认 LONG\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(1, qr.plan().functions().size(), \"1 个函数\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\"rn\", qr.plan().functions().get(0).alias(), \"别名\");\n    }\n\n    public void testDefaultNullOrderFollowsSqlStandard() {\n        QueryRequest asc = parse(simpleRequest());\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\n                windowengine.plan.NullOrder.FIRST,\n                asc.plan().window().orderBy().get(0).nullOrder(),\n                \"ASC 默认 NULLS FIRST\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\n                windowengine.plan.NullOrder.FIRST,\n                asc.plan().window().orderBy().get(0).nullOrder(),\n                \"裸排序键方向默认 ASC\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> req = simpleRequest();\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> win = (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"plan\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> w = (Map<String, Object>) win.get(\"window\");\n        w.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(Map.of(\"column\", \"a\", \"direction\", \"DESC\")));\n        QueryRequest desc = parse(req);\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\n                windowengine.plan.NullOrder.LAST,\n                desc.plan().window().orderBy().get(0).nullOrder(),\n                \"DESC 默认 NULLS LAST\");\n    }\n\n    public void testDefaultFrameDependsOnOrderBy() {\n        QueryRequest withOrder = parse(simpleRequest());\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\n                windowengine.plan.FrameBoundType.CURRENT_ROW,\n                withOrder.plan().window().frame().end().type(),\n                \"有 ORDER BY 时默认终点 CURRENT ROW\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\n                windowengine.plan.FrameBoundType.UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING,\n                withOrder.plan().window().frame().start().type(),\n                \"有 ORDER BY 时默认起点 UNBOUNDED PRECEDING\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> req = simpleRequest();\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> p = (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"plan\");\n        ((Map<?, ?>) p.get(\"window\")).remove(\"orderBy\");\n        p.put(\"functions\", List.of(sumDef(\"b\", \"s\")));\n        QueryRequest noOrder = parse(req);\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\n                windowengine.plan.FrameBoundType.UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING,\n                noOrder.plan().window().frame().end().type(),\n                \"无 ORDER BY 时默认帧延伸到分区末尾\");\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> sumDef(String col, String alias) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"function\", \"SUM\");\n        m.put(\"column\", col);\n        m.put(\"alias\", alias);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    public void testUnknownColumnRejected() {\n        Map<String, Object> req = simpleRequest();\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> p = (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"plan\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> w = (Map<String, Object>) p.get(\"window\");\n        w.put(\"partitionBy\", List.of(\"ghost\"));\n        EngineException e = expectError(() -> parse(req), \"不存在的分区列\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.COLUMN_NOT_FOUND.code(), e.code(), \"错误码\");\n    }\n\n    public void testDuplicateInputColumnRejected() {\n        Map<String, Object> req = simpleRequest();\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> d = (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"data\");\n        d.put(\"columns\", List.of(\"x\", \"X\"));\n        EngineException e = expectError(() -> parse(req), \"大小写重复列\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.DUPLICATE_COLUMN.code(), e.code(), \"重复列错误码\");\n    }\n\n    public void testDuplicateAliasRejected() {\n        Map<String, Object> req = simpleRequest();\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> p = (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"plan\");\n        p.put(\"functions\", List.of(\n                Map.of(\"function\", \"ROW_NUMBER\", \"alias\", \"rn\"),\n                Map.of(\"function\", \"RANK\", \"alias\", \"RN\")));\n        EngineException e = expectError(() -> parse(req), \"重复别名\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.DUPLICATE_COLUMN.code(), e.code(), \"别名大小写不敏感去重\");\n    }\n\n    public void testAliasClashesWithInputColumn() {\n        Map<String, Object> req = simpleRequest();\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> p = (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"plan\");\n        p.put(\"functions\", List.of(Map.of(\"function\", \"ROW_NUMBER\", \"alias\", \"a\")));\n        EngineException e = expectError(() -> parse(req), \"别名撞输入列\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.DUPLICATE_COLUMN.code(), e.code(), \"错误码\");\n    }\n\n    public void testRowWidthMismatchRejected() {\n        Map<String, Object> req = simpleRequest();\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> d = (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"data\");\n        d.put(\"rows\", List.of(List.of(1L, 2L, 3L)));\n        EngineException e = expectError(() -> parse(req), \"列数不符\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST.code(), e.code(), \"错误码\");\n    }\n\n    public void testDeclaredTypeMismatchRejected() {\n        Map<String, Object> data = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        data.put(\"columns\", List.of(Map.of(\"name\", \"s\", \"type\", \"STRING\")));\n        data.put(\"rows\", List.of(List.of(42L)));\n        Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        req.put(\"data\", data);\n        req.put(\"plan\", simpleRequest().get(\"plan\"));\n        EngineException e = expectError(() -> parse(req), \"STRING 列收到整数\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.TYPE_MISMATCH.code(), e.code(), \"类型错误码\");\n    }\n\n    public void testSumOnStringColumnRejected() {\n        Map<String, Object> data = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        data.put(\"columns\", List.of(\"s\"));\n        // 裸列名默认 LONG，这里用对象声明显式 STRING\n        data.put(\"columns\", List.of(Map.of(\"name\", \"s\", \"type\", \"STRING\")));\n        data.put(\"rows\", List.of(List.of(\"x\")));\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        Map<String, Object> plan = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        plan.put(\"window\", win);\n        plan.put(\"functions\", List.of(sumDef(\"s\", \"tot\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        req.put(\"data\", data);\n        req.put(\"plan\", plan);\n        EngineException e = expectError(() -> parse(req), \"SUM(STRING)\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.TYPE_MISMATCH.code(), e.code(), \"SUM 参数必须 LONG\");\n    }\n\n    public void testInvalidFrameRejected() {\n        Map<String, Object> req = simpleRequest();\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> p = (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"plan\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> w = (Map<String, Object>) p.get(\"window\");\n        Map<String, Object> bad = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        bad.put(\"mode\", \"ROWS\");\n        bad.put(\"start\", Map.of(\"type\", \"FOLLOWING\", \"offset\", 2));\n        bad.put(\"end\", Map.of(\"type\", \"PRECEDING\", \"offset\", 1));\n        w.put(\"frame\", bad);\n        EngineException e = expectError(() -> parse(req), \"起点晚于终点的帧\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME.code(), e.code(), \"非法帧错误码\");\n    }\n\n    public void testRangeFrameUnsupported() {\n        Map<String, Object> req = simpleRequest();\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> p = (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"plan\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> w = (Map<String, Object>) p.get(\"window\");\n        Map<String, Object> bad = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        bad.put(\"mode\", \"RANGE\");\n        bad.put(\"start\", Map.of(\"type\", \"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\"));\n        bad.put(\"end\", Map.of(\"type\", \"CURRENT_ROW\"));\n        w.put(\"frame\", bad);\n        EngineException e = expectError(() -> parse(req), \"RANGE 帧\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.UNSUPPORTED.code(), e.code(), \"RANGE 应报 UNSUPPORTED\");\n    }\n\n    public void testFrameTextParsing() {\n        RequestParser parser = new RequestParser();\n        var f1 = parser.parseFrameText(\"ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(windowengine.plan.FrameBoundType.PRECEDING,\n                f1.start().type(), \"文本帧起点类型\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(2L, f1.start().offset(), \"文本帧起点 offset\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(3L, f1.end().offset(), \"文本帧终点 offset\");\n\n        var f2 = parser.parseFrameText(\"rows unbounded preceding\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(windowengine.plan.FrameBoundType.UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING,\n                f2.start().type(), \"单边界帧起点\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(windowengine.plan.FrameBoundType.CURRENT_ROW,\n                f2.end().type(), \"单边界帧终点隐含 CURRENT ROW\");\n\n        EngineException e = expectError(\n                () -> parser.parseFrameText(\"ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING\"),\n                \"缺 AND 的文本帧\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.INVALID_FRAME.code(), e.code(), \"文本帧语法错误码\");\n    }\n\n    public void testUnknownFunctionRejected() {\n        Map<String, Object> req = simpleRequest();\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> p = (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"plan\");\n        p.put(\"functions\", List.of(Map.of(\"function\", \"DENSE_RANK\", \"alias\", \"dr\")));\n        EngineException e = expectError(() -> parse(req), \"未实现函数\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.UNSUPPORTED.code(), e.code(), \"不支持的函数\");\n    }\n\n    public void testDecimalsRejectedByJsonParser() {\n        String json =    Map<String, Object> plan = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        plan.put(\"window\", win);\n        plan.put(\"functions\", List.of(\n                Map.of(\"function\", \"ROW_NUMBER\"),\n                sumDef(\"v\", null) == null ? Map.of() : Map.of(\"function\", \"SUM\", \"column\", \"v\")));\n        Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        req.put(\"data\", data);\n        req.put(\"plan\", plan);\n        QueryRequest qr = parse(req);\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\"row_number1\", qr.plan().functions().get(0).alias(),\n                \"ROW_NUMBER 默认别名\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\"sum_v\", {"parentUuid":"8abad920-5fad-4808-9901-e56cd066fc5e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_r7zkkpjg7u75g6mw4u904yw2","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/b/tests/windowengine/SerializationTest.java","content":"package windowengine;\n\nimport windowengine.engine.WindowEngine;\nimport windowengine.plan.QueryPlan;\n\nimport java.nio.file.Path;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * JSON 序列化往返 + 导出目录测试：\n * - 输出关系导出后可直接作为 data.file 回读并再次执行，结果一致；\n * - 导出的 request.json 是可再次提交的规范化请求；\n * - 中文/转义字符的 JSON 往返不丢字。\n */\npublic final class SerializationTest {\n\n    private Map<String, Object> sampleRequest() {\n        Map<String, Object> data = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        data.put(\"columns\", List.of(\n                Map.of(\"name\", \"dept\", \"type\", \"STRING\"),\n                Map.of(\"name\", \"v\", \"type\", \"LONG\")));\n        data.put(\"rows\", List.of(\n                List.of(\"研发\", 10L),\n                List.of(\"销售\", null),\n                List.of(\"研发\", -5L)));\n\n        Map<String, Object> win = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        win.put(\"partitionBy\", List.of(\"dept\"));\n        win.put(\"orderBy\", List.of(Map.of(\"column\", \"v\",\n                \"direction\", \"ASC\", \"nullOrder\", \"FIRST\")));\n        win.put(\"frame\", \"ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> plan = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        plan.put(\"window\", win);\n        plan.put(\"functions\", List.of(\n                Map.of(\"function\", \"ROW_NUMBER\", \"alias\", \"rn\"),\n                Map.of(\"function\", \"RANK\", \"alias\", \"rk\"),\n                Map.of(\"function\", \"SUM\", \"column\", \"v\", \"alias\", \"cum\")));\n\n        Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        req.put(\"data\", data);\n        req.put(\"plan\", plan);\n        return req;\n    }\n\n    public void testJsonRoundTripPreservesValues() {\n        String text = Json.writePretty(sampleRequest());\n        Object reparsed = Json.parse(text);\n        String text2 = Json.writePretty(reparsed);\n        Asserts.assertEquals(text, text2, \"二次序列化应与首次完全一致（规范化）\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(text.contains(\"研发\"), \"中文字符应原样保留\");\n    }\n\n    public void testEscapeRoundTrip() {\n        String tricky = \"引号\\\"反斜杠\\\\换行\\n制表\\t\";\n        Map<String, Object> data = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        data.put(\"columns\", List.of(Map.of(\"name\", \"s\", \"type\", \"STRING\")));\n        data.put(\"rows\", List.of(List.of(tricky)));\n        Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        req.put(\"data\", data);\n        req.put(\"plan\", Map.of(\"functions\",\n                List.of(Map.of(\"function\", \"ROW_NUMBER\", \"alias\", \"rn\"))));\n        String json = Json.write(req);\n        QueryRequest parsed = new RequestParser().parse(Json.parse(json));\n        Asserts.assertEquals(tricky, parsed.data().rows().get(0).get(0).asString(),\n                \"转义字符往返\");\n    }\n\n    public void testExportedDataIsReusableAsInputFile() throws Exception {\n        Path dir = Path.of(\"build\", \"test-export-roundtrip\");\n        deleteDir(dir);\n\n        Map<String, Object> reqMap = sampleRequest();\n        QueryRequest first = new RequestParser().parse(reqMap);\n        Relation result1 = new WindowEngine().execute(first);\n        var files = new Exporter().export(first, result1, dir.toString());\n\n        // 用导出的 data.json 作为外部数据源重新发请求（data 只含 file 指针）\n        Map<String, Object> dataRef = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        dataRef.put(\"file\", files.dataFile().toString());\n        Map<String, Object> req2 = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        req2.put(\"data\", dataRef);\n        req2.put(\"plan\", JsonCodec.planToJson(first.plan()));\n        QueryRequest second = new RequestParser().parse(req2);\n        Relation result2 = new WindowEngine().execute(second);\n\n        Asserts.assertEquals(result1.rowCount(), result2.rowCount(), \"回读行数\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(result1.schema().size(), result2.schema().size(),\n                \"回读列数\");\n        for (int r = 0; r < result1.rowCount(); r++) {\n            for (int c = 0; c < result1.schema().size(); c++) {\n                Value a = result1.rows().get(r).get(c);\n                Value b = result2.rows().get(r).get(c);\n                Asserts.assertTrue(a.valueEquals(b),\n                        \"回读数据一致 行 \" + r + \" 列 \" + c);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 导出的规范化 request.json 也能直接再次执行\n        Object rerunNode = Json.parseFile(files.requestFile());\n        // 注意 request.json 的 data 是结果数据（带输出列），这里只验证它是结构合法的 JSON 对象，\n        // 且其 plan 部分可解析\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> rerun = (Map<String, Object>) rerunNode;\n        Asserts.assertTrue(rerun.containsKey(\"plan\"), \"导出请求包含 plan\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(rerun.containsKey(\"data\"), \"导出请求包含 data\");\n\n        deleteDir(dir);\n    }\n\n    public void testPlanExportExpandsDefaults() throws Exception {\n        // 不给 frame、不给 nullOrder、不给 direction，导出应全部显式展开\n        Map<String, Object> data = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        data.put(\"columns\", List.of(\"v\"));\n        data.put(\"rows\", List.of(List.of(1L)));\n        Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        req.put(\"data\", data);\n        req.put(\"plan\", Map.of(\n                \"window\", Map.of(\"orderBy\", List.of(\"v\")),\n                \"functions\", List.of(Map.of(\"function\", \"SUM\", \"column\", \"v\", \"alias\", \"s\"))));\n        QueryRequest qr = new RequestParser().parse(req);\n        Object planJson = JsonCodec.planToJson(qr.plan());\n        String text = Json.writePretty(planJson);\n        Asserts.assertTrue(text.contains(\"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\"), \"默认帧起点被展开\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(text.contains(\"CURRENT_ROW\"), \"默认帧终点被展开\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(text.contains(\"\\\"nullOrder\\\" : \\\"FIRST\\\"\"), \"默认 NULL 顺序被展开\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(text.contains(\"sqlText\"), \"帧导出带可读 SQL 文本\");\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public void testOutputColumnOrdering() {\n        Map<String, Object> req = sampleRequest();\n        QueryRequest qr = new RequestParser().parse(req);\n        Relation result = new WindowEngine().execute(qr);\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\"dept\", result.schema().name(0), \"原列在前\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\"v\", result.schema().name(1), \"原列顺序保持\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\"rn\", result.schema().name(2), \"输出列按函数声明顺序\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\"rk\", result.schema().name(3), \"输出列按函数声明顺序\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\"cum\", result.schema().name(4), \"输出列按函数声明顺序\");\n    }\n\n    private static void deleteDir(Path dir) throws Exception {\n        if (!java.nio.file.Files.exists(dir)) {\n            return;\n        }\n        try (var walk = java.nio.file.Files.walk(dir)) {\n            walk.sorted(java.util.Comparator.reverseOrder())\n                    .forEach(p -> {\n                        try {\n                            java.nio.file.Files.deleteIfExists(p);\n                        } catch (Exception ignored) {\n                            // 测试清理尽力而为\n                        }\n                    });\n        }\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_16c98014d26350cc872dcd5f","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":805,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":81720,"output_tokens":1970,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_r7zkkpjg7u75g6mw4u904yw2":{"content":"package      Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        req.put(\"data\", data);\n        req.put(\"plan\", Map.of(\"functions\",\n                List.of(Map.of(\"function\", \"ROW_NUMBER\", request.json 也能直接再次执行\n        Object rerunNode = Json.parseFile(files.requestFile());\n        // 注意 request.json 的 data 是结果数据（带输出列），这里只验证它是结构合法的 JSON 对象，\n        // 且其 plan 部分可解析\n Asserts.assertTrue(rerun.containsKey(\"data\"), \"导出请求包含 data\");\n\n        deleteDir(dir);\n    }\n\n    public void testPlanExportExpandsDefaults() throws Exception {\n        // 不给 frame、不给 Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        req.put(\"data\", data);\n        req.put(\"plan\", Map.of(\n                \"window\", Map.of(\"orderBy\", List.of(\"v\")),\n Asserts.assertEquals(\"rk\", result.schema().name(3), \"输出列按函数声明顺序\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(\"cum\", result.schema().name(4), \"输出列按函数声明顺序\");\n    }\n\n    private static void deleteDir(Path }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"1589a360-b107-4cb6-8c2a-14b950cdcb4e","session_id":"d67f3da5-4ea2-42a4-af1b-36f0c143d1cb","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/b","sessionId":"d67f3da5-4ea2-42a4-af1b-36f0c143d1cb","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp13-b","slug":"wiggly-stirring-candy"}

windowengine;\n\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Path;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 端到端测试：真正启动子进程执行 java windowengine.Main，\n * 验证 stdin/文件两种入口、退出码、stdout JSON 内容以及 --export 落盘效果。\n * 运行前提：测试 classpath 同时包含 build/classes 与 build/test-classes，\n * 由 scripts/run_tests.sh 保证。\n */\npublic final class EndToEndTest {\n\n    private record ProcResult(int exitCode, String stdout, String stderr) {\n    }\n\n    private static ProcResult runMain(List<String> args, String stdin) throws Exception {\n        String cp = System.getProperty(\"java.class.path\");\n        List<String> cmd = new java.util.ArrayList<>();\n        String javaBin = Path.of(System.getProperty(\"java.home\"), \"bin\", \"java\").toString();\n        cmd.add(javaBin);\n        cmd.add(\"-cp\");\n        cmd.add(cp);\n        cmd.add(\"windowengine.Main\");\n        cmd.addAll(args);\n\n        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(cmd);\n        Process p = pb.start();\n        if (stdin != null) {\n            p.getOutputStream().write(stdin.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));\n            p.getOutputStream().close();\n        }\n        String out = new String(p.getInputStream().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        String err = new String(p.getErrorStream().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        int code = p.waitFor();\n        return new ProcResult(code, out, err);\n    }\n\n    private String sampleRequestJson() {\n        return \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"data\": {\n                    \"columns\": [\n                      {\"name\": \"dept\", \"type\": \"STRING\"},\n                      {\"name\": \"v\", \"type\": \"LONG\"}\n                    ],\n                    \"rows\": [\n                      [\"A\", 1],\n                      [\"A\", 2],\n                      [\"B\", 10],\n                      [\"A\", null]\n                    ]\n                  },\n                  \"plan\": {\n                    \"window\": {\n                      \"partitionBy\": [\"dept\"],\n                      \"orderBy\": [{\"column\": \"v\", \"direction\": \"ASC\", \"nullOrder\": \"FIRST\"}],\n                      \"frame\": \"ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING\"\n                    },\n                    \"functions\": [\n                      {\"function\": \"ROW_NUMBER\", \"alias\": \"rn\"},\n                      {\"function\": \"RANK\", \"alias\": \"rk\"},\n                      {\"function\": \"SUM\", \"column\": \"v\", \"alias\": \"s\"}\n                    ]\n                  }\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n    }\n\n    public void testStdinSuccess() throws Exception {\n        ProcResult r = runMain(List.of(), sampleRequestJson());\n        Asserts.assertEquals(0, r.exitCode, \"成功退出码应为 0\");\n        Object parsed = Json.parse(r.stdout);\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> resp = (Map<String, Object>) parsed;\n        Asserts.assertEquals(Boolean.TRUE, resp.get(\"ok\"), \"响应 ok=true\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(4L, ((Number) resp.get(\"rowCount\")).longValue(), \"4 行结果\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(r.stdout.contains(\"\\\"rn\\\"\"), \"输出含 rn 列\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(r.stdout.contains(\"\\\"s\\\"\"), \"输出含 s 列\");\n    }\n\n    public void testFileArgumentSuccess() throws Exception {\n        Path reqFile = Files.createTempFile(\"window-req\", \".json\");\n        Files.writeString(reqFile, sampleRequestJson(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        ProcResult r = runMain(List.of(reqFile.toString()), null);\n        Asserts.assertEquals(0, r.exitCode, \"文件入口成功\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(r.stdout.contains(\"\\\"ok\\\" : true\"), \"文件入口响应\");\n        Files.deleteIfExists(reqFile);\n    }\n\n    public void testErrorExitCodeAndPayload() throws Exception {\n        // 引用不存在的列\n        String bad = sampleRequestJson().replace(\"\\\"dept\\\"\", \"\\\"ghost\\\"\");\n        ProcResult r = runMain(List.of(), bad);\n        Asserts.assertEquals(2, r.exitCode, \"请求错误退出码应为 2\");\n        Object parsed = Json.parse(r.stdout);\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> resp = (Map<String, Object>) parsed;\n        Asserts.assertEquals(Boolean.FALSE, resp.get(\"ok\"), \"ok=false\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> err = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"error\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(ErrorCode.COLUMN_NOT_FOUND.code(), err.get(\"code\"),\n                \"错误码透传\");\n    }\n\n    public void testOverflowThroughCli() throws Exception {\n        String req = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"data\": {\"columns\": [\"v\"], \"rows\": [[9223372036854775807], [1]]},\n                  \"plan\": {\n                    \"window\": {\"orderBy\": [{\"column\": \"v\"}],\n                      \"frame\": \"ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING\"},\n                    \"functions\": [{\"function\": \"SUM\", \"column\": \"v\", \"alias\": \"s\"}]\n                  }\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        ProcResult r = runMain(List.of(), req);\n        Asserts.assertEquals(2, r.exitCode, \"溢出应非零退出\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(r.stdout.contains(\"OVERFLOW\"), \"溢出错误码出现在输出: \" + r.stdout);\n    }\n\n    public void testExportWritesFiles() throws Exception {\n        Path exportDir = Path.of(\"build\", \"e2e-export\");\n        deleteDir(exportDir);\n        String withExport = sampleRequestJson().replaceFirst(\n                \"\\\"plan\\\"\",\n                \"\\\"export\\\": \\\"\" + exportDir.toString().replace(\"\\\\\", \"\\\\\\\\\") + \"\\\",\\n  \\\"plan\\\"\");\n        ProcResult r = runMain(List.of(), withExport);\n        Asserts.assertEquals(0, r.exitCode, \"带导出的请求成功: \" + r.stderr);\n        Asserts.assertTrue(Files.exists(exportDir.resolve(\"data.json\")), \"data.json 落盘\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(Files.exists(exportDir.resolve(\"plan.json\")), \"plan.json 落盘\");\n        Asserts.assertTrue(Files.exists(exportDir.resolve(\"request.json\")), \"request.json 落盘\");\n\n        // data.json 必须可回读且结构与响应一致\n        Object dataNode = Json.parseFile(exportDir.resolve(\"data.json\"));\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> data = (Map<String, Object>) dataNode;\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<Object> rows = (List<Object>) data.get(\"rows\");\n        Asserts.assertEquals(4, rows.size(), \"导出数据 4 行\");\n        deleteDir(exportDir);\n    }\n\n    public void testFrameTextViaCli() throws Exception {\n        // 验证 SQL 风格帧文本在真实 CLI 链路可用，且大偏移空帧返回 null\n        String req = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"data\": {\"columns\": NULL 不参与大小比较，按 nullOrder 独立成组（FIRST 恒小于任何非 NULL，LAST 恒大）；\n * 2. 非 NULL 的同类型值按 ASC/DESC 比较；LONG 与 STRING 之间比较抛 TYPE_MISMATCH；\n * 3. 全部排序键相等时，按原始行号升序兜底，保证结果确定性（ROW_NUMBER 的并列打破规则）。\n */\npublic final class RowComparator implements Comparator<Row> {\n\n    private final int[] columns;\n    private final Direction[] directions;\n    private final NullOrder[] nullOrders;\n\n    public RowComparator(Schema schema, List<OrderKey> keys) {\n        int n = keys.size();\n        this.columns = new int[n];\n        this.directions = new Direction[n];\n        this.nullOrders = new NullOrder[n];\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            OrderKey key = keys.get(i);\n            columns[i] = schema.requireIndex(key.column());\n            directions[i] = key.direction();\n            nullOrders[i] = key.nullOrder();\n        }\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public int compare(Row a, Row b) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {\n            Value va = a.get(columns[i]);\n            Value vb = b.get(columns[i]);\n            int cmp = compareOne(va, vb, nullOrders[i]);\n            if (directions[i] == Direction.DESC) {\n                cmp = -cmp;\n            }\n            if (cmp != 0) {\n                return cmp;\n            }\n        }\n        // 确定性兜底：稳定排序 + 原始行号\n        return Integer.compare(a.sourceIndex(), b.sourceIndex());\n    }\n\n    private static int compareOne(Value a, Value b, NullOrder nullOrder) {\n        if (a.isNull() || b.isNull()) {\n            if (a.isNull() && b.isNull()) {\n                return 0;\n            }\n            return a.isNull()\n                    ? (nullOrder == NullOrder.FIRST ? -1 : 1)\n                    : (nullOrder == NullOrder.FIRST ? 1 : -1);\n        }\n        return a.compareNonNull(b);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":42,"oldLines":9,"newStart":42,"newLines":21,"lines":["         for (int i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {","             Value va = a.get(columns[i]);","             Value vb = b.get(columns[i]);","-            int cmp = compareOne(va, vb, nullOrders[i]);","-            if (directions[i] == Direction.DESC) {","-                cmp = -cmp;","+            int cmp;","+            if (va.isNull() || vb.isNull()) {","+                // NULL 的位置只由 NULLS FIRST/LAST 决定，绝不随 ASC/DESC 翻转","+                if (va.isNull() && vb.isNull()) {","+                    cmp = 0;","+                } else {","+                    boolean aIsNull = va.isNull();","+                    boolean nullShouldBeFirst = nullOrders[i] == NullOrder.FIRST;","+                    cmp = (aIsNull == nullShouldBeFirst) ? -1 : 1;","+                }","+            } else {","+                cmp = va.compareNonNull(vb);","+                if (directions[i] == Direction.DESC) {","+                    cmp = -cmp;","+                }","             }","             if (cmp != 0) {","                 return cmp;"]},{"oldStart":53,"oldLines":16,"newStart":65,"newLines":4,"lines":["         // 确定性兜底：稳定排序 + 原始行号","         return Integer.compare(a.sourceIndex(), b.sourceIndex());","     }","-","-    private static int compareOne(Value a, Value b, NullOrder nullOrder) {","-        if (a.isNull() || b.isNull()) {","-            if (a.isNull() && b.isNull()) {","-                return 0;","-            }","-            return a.isNull()","-                    ?
